raw.description:
ABOUT ROOTSTOCK

Rootstock Software is a leading provider of native Cloud ERP on the Salesforce Platform. We empower manufacturing, distribution, and supply chain organizations to digitally transform their operations by delivering flexible, modern, and scalable ERP solutions. Our customers include some of the most innovative product-central companies across North America. We are the only ERP built natively on Salesforce, which means our customers run operations and CRM on one cloud platform rather than stitching a legacy ERP to their front office.

This is a remote position, based in the United States or Canada.
Please, no agencies/recruiters.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a high-performing Account Executive to drive new business across North America. In this individual contributor role you will own the full sales cycle, targeting mid-market to large enterprise companies in manufacturing, distribution, and supply chain. The role rewards a consultative, strategic seller who is comfortable teaching a buyer something they did not know and controlling a complex, multi-stakeholder evaluation. This is not a transactional product. Our buyers require education, business case development, and clear platform differentiation. We win by leading with insight.

DEAL PROFILE

  • Buying committee spans operations, IT, and finance, up to C-level
  • Competitive set is legacy and disconnected ERP, most often displaced by showing a unified operations and CRM platform

TERRITORY AND SUPPORT

  • A named territory of high-priority, best-fit accounts, typically $50M to $500M in revenue
  • A dedicated New Logo Hunting SDR partnered to your territory to accelerate outbound pipeline generation. While the SDR supports you, you are expected to independently source pipeline and proactively hunt new logo opportunities.
  • A Solutions Consultant to partner on discovery, solutioning, and demo
  • Marketing, ABM, and partner-led programs feeding your territory, plus the Salesforce ecosystem as a co-sell channel

DAY TO DAY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting through close
  • Drive net new customer acquisition across your named territory
  • Sell Rootstock ERP to Director, VP, and C-level stakeholders
  • Deliver tailored product demos, proposals, and business cases aligned to client needs
  • Navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes in complex enterprise environments
  • Build and execute a territory plan that generates meaningful self-sourced pipeline. Own pipeline creation alongside your dedicated SDR through strategic outbound prospecting, account-based hunting, networking, partner engagement, and executive outreach.
  • Partner with your SDR and Solutions Consultant to create and advance opportunities
  • Collaborate with pre-sales, implementation teams, and Salesforce ecosystem partners
  • Forecast accurately and manage your number with discipline

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 5 to 10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, ideally B2B SaaS
  • Proven success in complex B2B sales with deal values in the $50K to $500K+ range
  • Solid understanding of manufacturing and supply chain operations
  • Strong business acumen, with experience engaging IT, operations, and finance
  • Ability to build executive relationships and close multi-stakeholder deals
  • A self-motivated, results-driven professional with a consistent record of exceeding quota
  • A true hunter who self-sources pipeline and does not wait for leads to be handed over
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Familiarity with Salesforce-native or integrated ERP environments is a plus
  • Existing relationships with Salesforce account teams or ecosystem partners are a strong advantage

This position is commission eligible with a Base $160,000 USD / $220,000 CAD, with on-target earnings of $295,000 to $320,000 USD / $405,000 to $440,000 CAD, uncapped commission.

We offer our team members competitive compensation, world-class benefits, work-life balance (flexible schedules, telecommuting, vacation time off), and the opportunity to work alongside an amazing and supportive team!

Rootstock values diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Salary: $295,000 – $320,000 / year

Charter Sales Executive – Private Aviation & High-Ticket Sales

Full-Time | Remote | EST Hours + Rotating On-Call Coverage

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Charter Sales Executive to manage inbound private aviation inquiries, close high-value charter bookings, and build long-term relationships with premium clients.

This is a high-touch, relationship-driven sales role where speed, professionalism, and exceptional service directly impact revenue. You’ll guide clients from their initial flight request through booking and post-flight follow-up while coordinating closely with aviation operations teams.

If you have experience in private aviation, luxury services, high-ticket sales, travel, hospitality, or relationship-based selling, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

Charter Sales & Client Management

  • Manage and convert qualified inbound charter inquiries
  • Understand client travel needs and recommend appropriate aircraft solutions
  • Prepare quotes, discuss pricing, handle objections, and close bookings
  • Build relationships with high-net-worth individuals, executives, and corporate travelers
  • Drive repeat business through proactive relationship management

White-Glove Client Experience

  • Deliver responsive, polished service throughout the client journey
  • Communicate through phone, email, WhatsApp, and other channels
  • Handle urgent and time-sensitive requests professionally
  • Maintain discretion and attention to detail with premium clientele

Charter Coordination

  • Coordinate aircraft selection, scheduling, pricing, and booking requirements
  • Work closely with operations and aviation partners to ensure smooth execution
  • Keep clients informed from booking confirmation through post-flight follow-up
  • Participate in rotating on-call coverage when required

CRM & Pipeline Management

  • Maintain accurate records of inquiries, quotes, bookings, and client activity
  • Track opportunities and follow-ups in Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM platforms
  • Maintain clear pipeline visibility and organized client records

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in sales, business development, account management, or high-ticket client-facing roles
  • Strong relationship-building and consultative selling skills
  • Excellent spoken and written English
  • Confident working with premium and high-value clients
  • Strong organization, responsiveness, and follow-through
  • CRM experience
  • Ability to work EST hours with rotating on-call availability
  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Private aviation or charter sales experience
  • Luxury travel, hospitality, concierge, yacht charter, real estate, or other high-ticket sales experience
  • Familiarity with Avinode or charter quoting platforms
  • Knowledge of private aircraft categories and charter operations
  • Understanding of Part 135 operations
  • Experience serving high-net-worth clientele

What Success Looks Like

  • Strong inquiry-to-booking conversion rates
  • Consistent charter revenue generation
  • Fast response times to client inquiries
  • High client satisfaction and repeat bookings
  • Accurate CRM and pipeline management
  • Strong long-term client relationships

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High-value, relationship-driven sales
  • Exposure to the private aviation industry
  • Work directly with executives, entrepreneurs, and luxury travelers
  • Strong ownership of the client relationship
  • Fully remote environment
  • Growth opportunities into Senior Charter Sales, Sales Management, and Aviation Sales Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After applying, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to complete a short Intro Video. This gives the hiring team an opportunity to learn more about your sales background, communication style, client-facing experience, and approach to high-value relationships.

You can complete the recording on your own time and re-record your responses before submitting if needed.

Please check your inbox and spam/junk folder for the Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re a polished sales professional who thrives in high-ticket, relationship-driven environments and can deliver the responsiveness and service premium clients expect, we’d love to hear from you.

raw.description:
Marketing Manager

Remote, South Africa. Full-time, permanent, UK hours. R30,000 per month.

Read this before you apply

This is a senior seat at a company of four people. Nobody will train you and nobody has time to check your work. If you need a manager to break tasks down for you, this is not the job. If you have run the whole marketing channel for a small business and you are good at it, keep reading.

The company

Our client is a London-based AI training and transformation consultancy, a year and a half old, founder-led, growing. They teach leadership teams what AI can actually do for their business, then build it with them: data readiness, workflow analysis, AI literacy training, custom AI agents. Two founders, a small payroll, and a fractional CMO who sets direction.

The job

You run marketing end to end for a small, fast-growing business. The fractional CMO owns the strategy, the calendar and the priorities. Everything downstream of that is yours: you take the brief and you deliver it, properly, without being chased and without being taught.

You will be across all of it, social, content, email, events, analytics, paid. But we are not looking for someone who is average at everything. We want you to be genuinely strong in one or two areas and competent across the rest.

What you will actually do

  • Take a brief from the fractional CMO and execute it end to end, first time, to a standard nobody has to correct
  • Build and ship email campaigns and automated sequences in ActiveCampaign, including event follow-up flows segmented by who attended and who did not
  • Own the content and publishing calendar across LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram
  • Write. Short-form copy, campaign emails, social, show notes. You will not have a copywriter sitting next to you
  • Run the SEO programme: what topics the business should own, and the content that wins them
  • Run and optimise paid campaigns where they earn their place, and report honestly on what they cost and what they returned
  • Own comms for live events and online workshops, announcement through to post-event follow-up
  • Keep the tracking honest and produce a monthly report that tells the founders what moved and why
  • Use AI properly in daily production, not as a novelty

What you need

  • You have owned marketing end to end at a small business, a startup, or directly for founders. Not a slice of a large corporate marketing department. If your best work was one channel inside a big company, this will not suit you and we would rather say so now
  • Real depth in one or two areas. SEO and content, or Meta and paid social, or email and lifecycle, or analytics and attribution. Be excellent at something
  • Numbers you can defend. Not "improved engagement". What was it before, what was it after, what did the business get, and how do you know. You will be asked to walk through a campaign in detail, including what it cost per lead and why that figure is credible
  • Technical by instinct. You pick up new tools quickly, you have built things yourself, and you use AI because you understand what it can do, not because it is fashionable
  • You deliver alone. Remote, lightly managed, off a written brief, on time
  • Experienced enough to have been there and done it. This is not a first or second marketing job

Nice to have

  • ActiveCampaign specifically, though any serious automation platform transfers
  • Event marketing
  • Podcast or video production
  • Experience marketing a B2B service to business leaders

Two things we will ask you directly

What else are you contracted to do? This is a full-time role and it has to be your only one. We ask everybody, and we ask it first.

Walk me through a campaign you ran, with the numbers. Three of them, with the starting point as well as the finish. If you cannot do that from memory, do not apply yet.

What you get

Full ownership of marketing delivery at a company selling the thing every business is currently trying to work out, with a fractional CMO who knows what he wants and tells you clearly. Full-time, permanent, UK hours, paid in rands into a South African account. Employed through Remote Recruitment, working as part of the client's team.

Equipment

Reliable laptop, stable fibre, quiet professional home working setup.

Process

A recorded screening interview with us, then a task and a final conversation with the founder and the fractional CMO. You will hear back within 24 hours of every stage.

By joining the American Red Cross you will touch millions of lives every year and experience the greatness of the human spirit at its best. Are you ready to be part of the world's largest humanitarian network?

Join us—Where your Career is a Force for Good!

Job Description:

Joining The American Red Cross is like nothing else—it’s as much something you feel as something you do. You become a vital part of the world's largest humanitarian network, joining a team of welcoming individuals who are exceptional, yet unassuming; diverse, yet uncompromising in unity. You grow your career within a movement that matters, where success is measured in people helped, communities made whole, and individuals equipped to never stop changing lives and situations for the better.

When you choose to be a force for good, you'll have mentors who empower your growth along a purposeful career path. You align your life's work with an ongoing mission that's bigger than all of us. As you care for others, you're cared for with competitive compensation and benefits. You join a community that respects who you are away from work as much as what you do while at work.

The role is fully remote. East Coast candidates preferred.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW:

The American Red Cross is seeking a highly motivated, strategic, and exceptionally organized Sr. Manager, Digital Content Strategy & Operations to lead digital content strategy, experience optimization, and operations across key Biomedical Services digital properties, including RedCrossBlood.org and the Blood Donor App.

This is a high-impact role for a leader who can move comfortably between strategy and execution—someone who can take complex, ambiguous initiatives, synthesize information, create clarity and structure, and drive the details through completion.

A significant initial focus will be serving as the content strategy and project management lead for a major organizational website redesign and re-platform. The role will help guide the organization through content strategy, information architecture, content migration, localization/multilingual requirements, stakeholder alignment, implementation, quality assurance, launch, and post-launch optimization. This individual will work across departments and lines of service to help create a transformational digital experience.

At the same time, this leader will own the day-to-day digital content operating model for RedCrossBlood.org, the Blood Donor App, and other digital properties. They will serve as the central project manager and content strategist for digital requests, translating business objectives into compelling digital experiences and coordinating cross-functional teams through discovery, UX, content, design, SEO, accessibility, implementation, QA, and launch.

The ideal candidate is hungry for impact, highly accountable, intellectually curious, and energized by complexity. They can see the big picture while relentlessly managing the details. They know how to ask the right questions, bring structure to ambiguity, influence stakeholders, and keep work moving. They are equally comfortable developing a strategy, facilitating a working session, building a project plan, reviewing a wireframe, editing content, analyzing performance data, and working in a CMS to ensure the work is implemented correctly.

This role reports to the Senior Director of Digital Marketing.

Key Responsibilities:

Digital Transformation, Project & Program Management

  • Serve as the primary content strategy and project management lead for the organizational website redesign and re-platform, with an initial focus on RedCrossBlood.org and related content.
  • Lead the content workstream from discovery and strategy through planning, migration, localization, implementation, QA, launch, and post-launch optimization.
  • Translate complex, cross-functional initiatives into clear strategies, workplans, milestones, dependencies, requirements, owners, and next steps.
  • Establish processes that enable stakeholders across departments and lines of service to effectively participate in content planning, review, migration, and implementation.
  • Manage timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, resources, and stakeholder reviews, escalating issues and removing roadblocks as needed.
  • Partner with UX, design, technology, SEO, analytics, marketing, product, engagement, and business stakeholders to ensure content and experience decisions are integrated.
  • Drive content strategy through the creation and review of content briefs, ensuring content meets brand and digital best practices, identifying components, and how we can transform today’s content into tomorrow’s experience.
  • Support multilingual and Spanish-language content requirements in partnership with translation partners, ensuring translated content maintains the intended user experience, accuracy, and conversion objectives.

Digital Content Strategy & Operations

  • Own the end-to-end content process across RedCrossBlood.org, the Blood Donor App, and other digital properties from discovery and requirements through content development, design, implementation, QA, launch, and ongoing optimization.
  • Develop and execute content strategies that use digital experiences to achieve measurable business objectives, including increasing blood donation appointments, engagement, and lead generation.
  • Lead promotional content across web and app, including homepage experiences, campaign placements, in-app promotions, badges, feature announcements, terms and conditions, and other high-priority content.
  • Evaluate business and stakeholder digital content requests through the lens of user needs, customer journeys, content strategy, UX, SEO, accessibility, platform capabilities, and conversion best practices.
  • Partner with UX and design teams to develop user journeys, wireframes, page structures, component requirements, and experiences that make it easy for users to find information and take action.
  • Ensure content is structured and optimized for modern search experiences, including SEO and emerging answer-engine/AI search optimization (AEO).
  • Identify opportunities to connect web and app capabilities, including deep linking, journey optimization, personalization, and other enhancements that create a more connected digital experience.
  • Write, edit, or direct content development as needed, ensuring content is compelling, concise, user-centered, on-brand, and designed to drive action.
  • Serve as a hands-on digital content leader who can establish the strategy and ensure execution meets a high standard.

Data, Analytics & Continuous Optimization

  • Establish and monitor KPIs for digital content and experiences in partnership with marketing, analytics, engagement, and business teams.
  • Translate data and analytics into clear insights, recommendations, and prioritized actions.
  • Develop and maintain reporting dashboards and recurring performance reporting that provide actionable visibility into digital performance.

Accessibility, Governance & Best Practices

  • Serve as a digital content accessibility lead and liaison, partnering with appropriate teams to ensure digital content and experiences meet accessibility standards and provide an inclusive experience for all users.
  • Conduct and coordinate regular content audits, identifying opportunities to improve accessibility, usability, content quality, SEO, and overall digital experience.
  • Develop documentation, governance, workflows, templates, and operating processes that make digital content work more efficient, scalable, and consistent.

Additional duties may be assigned as the discretion of the Sr. Director, Digital Marketing.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience in communications, marketing, English, digital media, business, or a related field.
  • 6-10+ years of relevant experience* in digital marketing, digital experience, content strategy, web, digital product, content operations, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex web or digital initiatives from strategy through implementation, launch, and optimization.
  • Experience managing cross-functional digital programs involving multiple stakeholder groups and influencing outcomes without direct authority.
  • Experience with content management systems; Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of digital content strategy and experience best practices, including UX, information architecture, SEO, accessibility, content structure, imagery, and conversion.
  • Ability to develop digital content including copywriting, selecting imagery, and having a vision for page content and the action users should take or experience.
  • Experience using web analytics and performance data to inform digital strategy and optimization; Adobe Analytics preferred.
  • Exceptional project management, organizational, prioritization, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas and create clear documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a complex, matrixed organization and build alignment across functions.
  • Should be self-motivated – this position is fully remote.
  • Exceptional communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams

*Combination of candidate’s education and general experience satisfies requirements so long as the total years equate to description’s minimum education and general experience years combined (Management experience cannot be substituted).

PAY INFORMATION: The annual salary range for this position is $115,000 - $125,000. We do not offer an annual bonus for this role. Note that American Red Cross salaries are aligned to the specific geographic location in which the work is primarily performed. Other factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills, how many years of experience you have and comparison to other employees already in this role. **We will review specific salary information at the time of phone screening based upon your location & experience.**

BENEFITS FOR YOU:

As a mission-based organization, we believe our team needs great support to do great work. Our comprehensive package includes:

· Medical, Dental Vision plans

· Health Spending Accounts & Flexible Spending Accounts

· PTO: Starting at 15 days a year; based on type of job and tenure

· Holidays: 11 paid holidays comprised of six core holidays and five floating holidays

· 401K with up to 6% match

· Paid Family Leave

· Employee Assistance

· Disability and Insurance: Short + Long Term

· Service Awards and recognition

*LI-JG1

Apply now! Joining our team will provide you with the opportunity to

make your career a force for good!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

​

About the job

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: Applied Legal Benchmark Specialist
Type:Contract
Compensation:$83–$105/hour
Location:Remote
Commitment:10+ hours/week

Role Responsibilities

  • Author original law questions to test deep conceptual understanding, not surface-level recall.
  • Ensure questions are unambiguous, self-contained, and precisely defined with all necessary information in the problem statement.
  • Rate each question's difficulty: Medium (intro undergraduate), Hard (advanced undergraduate), or Expert (post-graduate and above).
  • Provide 1 correct answer and 9 plausible but subtly incorrect alternatives to challenge expert-level solvers.
  • Write step-by-step Chain-of-Thought solutions with clear, concise reasoning in markdown format.
  • Supply 1–5 academic references per question from reputable sources like peer-reviewed journals and legal repositories.
  • For verification tasks: flag issues with clarity, completeness, precision, or solvability and justify any edits made.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • JD, LLM, SJD, or doctoral candidate in Law or a closely related field.
  • Master's degree considered for candidates with exceptional depth in a specific subdomain.
  • Strong command of legal reasoning, statutory interpretation, and jurisprudential theory.
  • Excellent written English and ability to express complex legal ideas clearly and concisely.

Preferred

  • Experience with bar exam writing, legal academia, or judicial clerkships is a strong plus.

Position Purpose:
Assist the Chief Medical Director to direct and coordinate the medical management, quality improvement and credentialing functions for the business unit.

  • Provides medical leadership of all for utilization management, cost containment, and medical quality improvement activities.
  • Performs medical review activities pertaining to utilization review, quality assurance, and medical review of complex, controversial, or experimental medical services, ensuring timely and quality decision making.
  • Supports effective implementation of performance improvement initiatives for capitated providers.
  • Assists Chief Medical Director in planning and establishing goals and policies to improve quality and cost-effectiveness of care and service for members.
  • Provides medical expertise in the operation of approved quality improvement and utilization management programs in accordance with regulatory, state, corporate, and accreditation requirements.
  • Assists the Chief Medical Director in the functioning of the physician committees including committee structure, processes, and membership.
  • Conduct regular rounds to assess and coordinate care for high-risk patients, collaborating with care management teams to optimize outcomes.
  • Collaborates effectively with clinical teams, network providers, appeals team, medical and pharmacy consultants for reviewing complex cases and medical necessity appeals.
  • Participates in provider network development and new market expansion as appropriate.
  • Assists in the development and implementation of physician education with respect to clinical issues and policies.
  • Identifies utilization review studies and evaluates adverse trends in utilization of medical services, unusual provider practice patterns, and adequacy of benefit/payment components.
  • Identifies clinical quality improvement studies to assist in reducing unwarranted variation in clinical practice in order to improve the quality and cost of care.
  • Interfaces with physicians and other providers in order to facilitate implementation of recommendations to providers that would improve utilization and health care quality.
  • Reviews claims involving complex, controversial, or unusual or new services in order to determine medical necessity and appropriate payment.
  • Develops alliances with the provider community through the development and implementation of the medical management programs.
  • As needed, may represent the business unit before various publics both locally and nationally on medical philosophy, policies, and related issues.
  • Represents the business unit at appropriate state committees and other ad hoc committees.
  • May be required to work weekends and holidays in support of business operations, as needed.

Education/Experience:

  • Medical Doctor or Doctor of Osteopathy.
  • Utilization Management experience and knowledge of quality accreditation standards preferred.
  • Actively practices medicine.
  • Course work in the areas of Health Administration, Health Financing, Insurance, and/or Personnel Management is advantageous.
  • Experience treating or managing care for a culturally diverse population preferred.

License/Certifications:

  • Board certification in a medical specialty recognized by the American Board of Medical Specialists or the American Osteopathic Association’s Department of Certifying Board Services.
  • Active Certification in Internal or Family Medicine, preferred.
  • Current state license as a MD or DO without restrictions, limitations, or sanctions from government programs.
Pay Range: $236,500.00 - $449,300.00 per year

You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. This is a full-time W-2 executive role (not 1099) where you'll serve as the marketing partner to a portfolio of law firm clients — setting strategy, building systems, coaching owners, and driving measurable growth — without ever having to find or sell the engagements yourself.

PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

This role requires 12+ years of senior marketing leadership, including 10+ years specifically holding the title of Chief Marketing Officer or Fractional CMO — not VP of Marketing, Head of Marketing, Director of Marketing, or similar. If your senior marketing experience was earned under a VP, Director, or Head of Marketing title, this role is not the right fit, regardless of the scope of responsibility in that role.

Within that CMO/Fractional CMO tenure, you must show sustained, concurrent experience managing multiple client relationships at the same time, specifically advising small to mid-sized businesses ($5M–$30M+ revenue) as your primary, ongoing clients, not as single projects or side engagements.

❌ Held VP, Director, or Head of Marketing titles, even with CMO-level scope of responsibility? Not the right fit — this role requires the CMO title itself.
❌ Held the CMO title, but it was a single interim gig or in-house role at one company, not concurrent multi-client work? Not the right fit.
❌ Held the CMO title primarily at large enterprises, without sustained hands-on SMB owner advisory? Not the right fit.

Must currently reside in one of the states listed above and be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

APPLICATION QUESTIONS

  1. List each role in which you held the specific title of "Chief Marketing Officer" or "Fractional CMO," along with the dates for each. (Titles such as VP of Marketing, Head of Marketing, or Director of Marketing do not qualify, even if the scope of the role was similar.)
  2. Describe 2-3 client engagements from the last 3-5 years that you managed concurrently (at the same time, not sequentially) while holding a CMO or Fractional CMO title. Include each client's approximate revenue, engagement duration, and your role.

WHY THIS BEATS RUNNING YOUR OWN PRACTICE

  • No business development — we bring you a full portfolio; you never chase your next engagement
  • Predictable income + upside — guaranteed base plus performance compensation
  • Scale without the overhead — systems and support staff already in place

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Brand Strategy & Positioning
  • Marketing Execution across digital and traditional channels
  • Performance & Metrics — KPIs and analytics tied to decision-making
  • Coaching & Advisory — mentoring owners and internal marketing teams

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 12+ years senior marketing leadership, including 10+ years specifically as CMO or Fractional CMO
  • Direct, concurrent multi-client experience under that title — not sequential engagements
  • Data-driven approach; skilled at coaching non-marketing executives
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent leadership experience
  • Legal, agency, or consulting industry experience a plus (not required — we'll train you on the legal side)

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • $110,000 base + performance comp ($182,000+ OTE)
  • Medical, dental, vision (75% employer-paid); short/long-term disability
  • 401(k) match | Unlimited PTO + paid Thanksgiving-week shutdown
  • 100% remote

Apply Today

Become the marketing leader growing law firms rely on to build their brand, generate leads, and scale successfully — with a team, systems, and pipeline already built around you.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel is actively recruiting for an experienced Global Study Manager to join us in Poland/Spain.

Temporary position (until April 2027)

100% remote.

Sponsor dedicated.

In this role you will provide leadership and direction to the trial team and is accountable for the overall success and delivery of their assigned clinical trial according to defined milestones and KPI’s.

You will be responsible for steering and directing clinical trial activities, including patient and site engagement activities, direct communication and interaction with multiple internal and external stakeholders, and team members on a global, multi country or regional basis.

Some specifics about this advertised role

  • Accountable for the accurate planning and operational feasibility of trial timelines; and oversight of trial preparation to ensure trial team members are aligned and on track. Supports development of trial level documents owned by other functions (e.g. Statistics, Data Management, Study Physician, Medical Writing, Site Monitoring).

  • Verifies and provides input into the country allocation and oversees trial feasibility.

  • Maintains oversight during clinical trial conduct including adherence to GCP and all global and local regulatory requirements; compliance with SOPs and continuous risk monitoring/mitigation. In collaboration with other functions, ensures budget oversight, including support of regular clinical quality monitoring, SMC/DMC management and safety reporting.

  • Prepare and implement amendments of core documents, including training material updates/retraining as needed.

  • Support authority/ethics response to requests as applicable

  • In collaboration with other functions, ensures timely cleaning and delivery of clinical trial data. Coordinates and supports trial medical writer in providing the CTR.

  • Responding for timely, complete and compliant archiving of all relevant global documents in the TMF, including all required documents from vendors.

  • Support results/documents disclosure of global registries.

Who are Parexel

Parexel supports clinical studies across the full range of therapeutic areas, and we have longstanding partnerships with a vast client base.

We supported the trials of most of today’s top 50 best-selling drugs, but equally we enable more niche drug developments that are critical to the well-being of many patients.

What we are looking for in this role

For every role, we look for professionals who have the determination and courage always to put patient well-being first.

That to us is working with heart.

Here are a few requirements specific to this advertised role.

  • Bachelor’s degree and minimum 6 years of relevant global study management/leadership experience

  • Experience with oversight of CROs and vendors

  • Experience in managing per subject costs, vendor and ancillary and monitoring costs projections and spend

  • Fluency in written and spoken English required

  • Ability to work outside of core business hours, as required, to support global trials or initiatives

  • Ability to travel, as required, including IMs, vendor kick off and re-set meetings, and client internal global or department level meetings

  • Technical proficiency in trial management systems and MS applications, including but not limited to Teams, MS Office, Project, CTMS, EDC, IWRS/IVRS.

  • Knowledge of ICH GCP and relevant regulatory guidelines/directives.

  • Demonstrated interpersonal & leadership skills.

  • Ability to understand and implement the strategic direction and guidance for respective clinical studies.

  • Effective communication skills via verbal, written and presentation abilities.

BSN SPORTS, A VARSITY BRANDS COMPANY - THE RECOGNIZED LEADER IN TEAM ATHLETIC GEAR

For over 50 years, BSN SPORTS has been the largest team sporting goods equipment and apparel distributor of choice in the United States. Our 3,000 BSN SPORTS employees strive to support the Heart of the Game by putting valuable time back into the day of coaches and administrators through excellent service platforms. Our company mission is simple: Save coaches and administrators time with everything they do off the field so they have more time to impact young lives on it.

WORK TYPE: Full time, exempt

LOCATION DETAILS: Remote

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS: Some travel required

PAY RATE: The salary range is $60,000- $75,000 annually.

The base salary will vary based on criteria such as education, experience and qualifications of the applicant, location, internal equity, and alignment with the market.

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

The LAX National Account Manager will serve as a best-in-class sales representative within the company capable of serving medium, large and enterprise organizations – National Accounts.

Since 2000, Lax.com has been the go-to destination for players, coaches, teams, and fans who live and breathe lacrosse. We partner with the sport’s top brands to bring athletes the best gear, prioritizing innovation, safety, and style. Simply put—Lax.com is where players get their gear.

Beyond retail, we proudly collaborate with thousands of teams across the U.S. and Canada to design, produce, and deliver custom uniforms, spirit wear, and equipment. With a relentless focus on quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction, we ensure every order is delivered on time, with precision, and to the highest standards.

An Account Manager will represent LAX / BSN Sports by demonstration of company core values in driving the highest ethical standards of conduct in all business activities.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Manage and grow an assigned book of business through proactive relationship management and strategic account support.
  • Maintain consistent daily communication with customers, ensuring all emails and text messages are responded to within 24 hours.
  • Develop and present quarterly account plans for key customers in collaboration with management to support retention and growth goals.
  • Communicate both positive updates and challenging issues to customers professionally, transparently, and in a timely manner.
  • Partner with customers to create customized logo concepts and product designs that align with brand standards and team identity.
  • Build and manage online team stores to support customer fundraising, ordering, and product distribution needs.
  • Support accounts receivable efforts by assisting customers through billing inquiries and aging AR resolution.
  • Participate in professional development opportunities and lacrosse industry events on a quarterly basis to strengthen product knowledge and industry relationships.
  • Utilize approved expense budgets strategically to foster and maintain strong client relationships.
  • Process bulk customer orders accurately and efficiently, with a target turnaround time of 12 hours or less.

QUALIFICATIONS

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Sales Acumen
  • Organizational Skills
  • Communication Proficiency
  • Technical Capacity and Training
  • Collaboration Skills
  • Time Management Skills
  • Personal Effectiveness/Credibility
  • Customer Service

Education/Experience

  • A minimum of four years of management and/or sales experience.
  • A minimum of two years of industry experience.
  • Lacrosse experience and product knowledge.
  • Bachelor's Degree preferred

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The physical demands that are described as required are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Prolonged periods of sitting, standing, bending, lifting, kneeling and walking will all occur on a regular basis.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job.

OUR VALUES

Service - We lead with heart. We champion community.

Passion - We love what we do. It fuels our purpose.

Integrity - We do what we promise. We own our actions and decisions.

Respect - We earn it by giving it. Because everyone deserves it.

Innovation - We never stop striving to be better. For ourselves and our community.

Transparency - We are committed to openness and honesty in everything we do.

OUR BENEFITS

We are committed to putting you and your families first. For benefits eligible roles, we offer a variety of choices and costs as well as program enhancements that align with our responsibility to elevate the employee experience. Some of our offerings include:

  • Comprehensive Health Care Benefits
  • HSA Employer Contribution/ FSA Opportunities
  • Wellbeing Program
  • 401(k) plan with company matching
  • Company paid Life, AD&D, and Short-Term Disability
  • Generous My Time Off & Paid Holidays
  • Varsity Brands Ownership Program
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Access to Financial Coaching and member-owned Credit Union
  • St. Jude Partnership & Volunteer Opportunities
  • Employee Perks including discounts on personal apparel and equipment!

Eligibility for company-sponsored benefits is determined by scheduled work hours, and the terms of the applicable benefit plans. Benefit offerings and eligibility requirements may vary by position and are subject to change in accordance with plan documents and applicable law.

raw.title: Senior Mobile Software Engineer (Android)
raw.excerpt: We are looking for a Senior Android Engineer who is architecturally strong, quality-driven, and AI-native to join our Mobile Engineering team.
raw.description:
We are looking for a Senior Android Engineer who is architecturally strong, quality-driven, and AI-native to join our Mobile Engineering team. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to own Android architecture decisions, ship polished Kotlin applications, and set the standard for how AI accelerates engineering at Xsolla.
Deep expertise in modern Android is essential: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines and Flow, and the Jetpack library surface, along with a proven track record of shipping commercial applications to Google Play from concept to launch. The ability to design scalable architectures, implement robust testing strategies, profile and optimize startup time, jank, memory, and battery across a fragmented device landscape, and mentor other engineers while collaborating across cross-functional teams will be key to your success in this role.
We build AI-first. We expect you to work fluently with AI coding agents as a daily multiplier - scoping work for them, reviewing what they produce with a critical eye, and building the internal tooling, context, and evaluation habits that make the whole team faster.
If you’re passionate about building high-quality Android experiences that scale, and love shipping apps that power gaming, virtual currency, and digital commerce experiences, we would love to hear from you!

ABOUT US

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.
For more information, visit xsolla.com.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain our native Android application in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, used by players and developers worldwide.
  • Deliver high-quality features on time throughout the development lifecycle, from technical design through release and post-launch iteration.
  • Own the full Android release process: signing, App Bundles, Play Console tracks, staged rollouts, pre-launch reports, and crash and ANR triage.
  • Implement best practices for Android development, including code review, automated testing strategies, and CI/CD with Gradle, Fastlane, or equivalent.
  • Integrate mini-apps, payments, and virtual currency systems into the Xsolla App ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with product and design teams to turn business goals into experiences that feel genuinely native.
  • Work with cross-functional teams, including backend developers, QA engineers, and project managers, and communicate effectively across distributed, multi-timezone teams.
  • Participate in technical discussions to align development work with business objectives.

Architecture & Design

  • Design and implement scalable application architecture for Android with a focus on maintainability, performance, and developer experience.
  • Lead architectural decisions around modularization, dependency injection (Hilt/Dagger), navigation, and state management (MVVM, MVI, unidirectional data flow).
  • Configure and optimize the Gradle build, convention plugins, version catalogs, build caching, and configuration cache, for fast, incremental builds.
  • Build and maintain an internal Compose component library and design system implementation.
  • Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and best practices across the mobile development team.
  • Create technical specifications and architecture documentation for complex features and systems.
  • Partner with the iOS and React Native engineers to keep shared API contracts, design tokens, feature flags, and analytics schemas coherent across the app family, without flattening the platform into a lowest common denominator.
  • Drive observability for mobile: structured logging, crash monitoring, performance tracing, and release health dashboards.

AI-First Engineering

  • Use AI coding agents and assistants as a core part of your daily workflow, and raise the bar for how the team prompts, reviews, and verifies AI-generated code.
  • Build and maintain the context that makes agents effective in our codebase: project rules, tool integrations, reproducible dev environments, and automated checks that catch what review misses.
  • Design evaluation and guardrails for AI features, including prompt regression testing, fallback behavior, and handling of model failure modes in production.
  • Share what works: mentor engineers on AI-assisted development and help set practical, quality-preserving standards for the organization.

Qualifications & Skills

Who we are

At CloudFactory, we are a mission-driven team passionate about unlocking the disruptive potential of AI for the world. Our culture

At CloudFactory, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels empowered, valued, and inspired to bring their authentic selves to work. We are:

  • Mission-driven: we focus on creating economic and social impact.
  • People-centric: we care deeply about our team's growth, well-being, and sense of belonging.
  • Innovative: we embrace change and find better ways to do things, together.
  • Globally connected: we foster collaboration between diverse cultures and perspectives.

Location: Japan
Project type: One-time paid project
Time commitment: Approximately 1–2 hours
Compensation: $75 for completing the project activity

About the opportunity

CloudFactory is looking for participants to support a short-term transaction validation project that we are administering on behalf of a global payments processing company.

The project is designed to help evaluate the accuracy of how payment transactions are matched to individuals.

As a participant, you'll review a set of recent payment transactions and indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself.

How it works

If selected for the project:

  1. You'll provide the email address(es) you use with selected merchants, subscriptions, apps, or online accounts.
  2. Our payments processing client will use those email address(es) to identify payment transactions it believes are associated with you and securely provide a list of those transactions for the project.
  3. You'll be presented with approximately 50 recent transactions from the last 3 months through the designated project platform. The information shown may include details such as the merchant name, date, amount, payment method, card identifier, and card issuer to help you recognize each transaction.
  4. You'll indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself and, where helpful, add a short note.

The activity is expected to take approximately 1–2 hours.

You will not be asked to provide or upload your own transaction history, bank statements, full card number, online banking login credentials, banking password, PIN, or CVV.

Please note that this is a data validation activity only.

Requirements

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Currently reside in Japan.
  • Be an active debit and/or credit card user.
  • Have made purchases or payments within the last three months across a variety of merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be able to recognize your own recent purchases and transactions.
  • Have access to the email address(es) you use with the merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be comfortable providing those email address(es) if selected for the project.
  • Be willing to review approximately 50 transactions and confirm whether or not you recognize them as your own.

Privacy and consent

Because this project involves personal and financial transaction information, privacy and informed consent are essential.

Before participating, you'll receive our Participant Consent & Confidentiality Terms, which explain how your personal information and transaction data will be used and processed as part of the project.

If you qualify and provide your consent, relevant payment transactions will be securely provided to CloudFactory by the end-customer and made available to you through the designated project platform for validation.

You may withdraw your consent and participation in accordance with the terms provided to you before the project begins.

Interested? Complete our short eligibility questionnaire to be considered for this paid project.

Rather than repeating your background during multiple screening calls, you’ll tell your story once, allowing future interviews to focus on meaningful conversations.

Don’t overthink it—you can record as many takes as you’d like before submitting. Your invitation will come from Spark Hire, so please check both your inbox and spam folder.

Marketing Success Manager

Company: Ekwa Marketing Department: Client Success / Marketing Reports to: [Director of Client Success / Senior Management] Location: [Office / Remote] Employment type: Full-time

Position Summary

The Marketing Success Manager is the strategic partner and primary point of contact for our clients, owning both the relationship and the marketing outcomes that keep them with Ekwa long-term. Evolving from the traditional Client Success Manager role, this position blends account retention and relationship management with direct accountability for marketing performance and ROI.

Working with dental, medical, and other healthcare practice owners, the Marketing Success Manager ensures each client clearly understands the value Ekwa delivers, sees measurable results from their SEO, website, social media, and online advertising campaigns, and is confident in renewing and growing their partnership. The role bridges the client and Ekwa's specialist marketing teams to turn marketing activity into business growth for the client

Key Responsibilities

Client Success & Retention

  • Serve as the dedicated point of contact for an assigned portfolio of client accounts, building trusted, long-term relationships.
  • Lead regular review meetings, and strategy sessions, ensuring expectations are set and met.
  • Drive client retention, renewals, and satisfaction; proactively identify and address churn risk.
  • Identify opportunities to expand accounts through additional services that genuinely benefit the client.

Marketing Strategy & Performance

  • Monitor campaign results across SEO, website, social media, reputation, and paid advertising, and drive optimization to improve ROI.
  • Interpret marketing data and analytics to make recommendations that grow client leads, new patients, and revenue.
  • Stay current on digital marketing trends and best practices relevant to the healthcare/dental sector.

Reporting & Communication

  • Present clear, results-focused performance reports that connect marketing metrics to client business outcomes.
  • Communicate progress, wins, and next steps to clients in a way that is transparent and easy to understand.
  • Manage client expectations professionally, handling concerns with empathy and timely follow-through.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Act as the liaison between clients and Ekwa's specialist teams (SEO, web design, content, social media, advertising), ensuring deliverables align with client goals.
  • Brief internal teams on client objectives and feed back client priorities to keep work on track.
  • Collaborate with leadership on process improvements that raise the standard of client service and results.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 1+ years of experience in client success, account management, or digital marketing — preferably in an agency environment.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing channels: SEO, websites, social media, online reputation, and paid advertising.
  • Experience working with performance data and marketing analytics tools.
  • Experience serving healthcare, dental, or professional-services clients is an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong relationship-building and client-facing communication skills.
  • Ability to translate marketing data into clear business value for non-marketing clients.
  • Strategic thinking combined with hands-on attention to detail.
  • Organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple accounts simultaneously.
  • Comfortable presenting results and leading client meetings with confidence.
  • Collaborative team player who works effectively across departments.

STARTING PAY 50,000 CAD (Annual) + 10,000 CAD (Annual Bonus on performance)

Special Education Teacher is the teacher of record for their students and provides instruction, support and guidance and manages the learning process focusing on self-contained and ALT students’ individual needs as defined by each student’s Individual Education Program (IEP). This role is also responsible for progress monitoring on goals and service logs as required in serving special education students and for all compliance documents required in serving self-contained and ALT students.

raw.title: Vice President of Sales
raw.excerpt: Packback’s mission is to empower every student to be fearlessly curious and find their unique voice.
raw.description:
Packback’s mission is to empower every student to be fearlessly curious and find their unique voice.

These few words shape everything we do at Packback from the smallest decision to the largest. Over the last decade since our company’s founding, our team has seen first-hand the power of giving students intentionally designed spaces in their learning experience to be autonomous and curious. We have also seen the incredible benefits of using AI technology to shorten feedback loops and help students revise their work before they submit.

Packback is a pedagogy partner that uses technology as a “means to an end” to shorten feedback loops for students and instructors, improve writing and critical thinking skills, and cultivate student-centered, trust-based educational learning environments.

Packback partners with 600+ higher education and K-12 institutions and is backed by growth equity firm PSG, with a platform proven to improve student writing confidence and cut instructor grading time by 30%.

About the role

We're looking for a VP of Sales to lead and scale Packback's sales organization as we grow our presence across higher education. This role combines executive-level strategy with hands-on leadership of the team responsible for new enterprise business — setting the overall direction for how Packback sells, structures, staffs, and compensates its sales function, while staying close enough to the field to coach Account Executives through institutional partnerships and faculty-driven adoption. You'll partner directly with the CEO and cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations to set sales strategy, build the infrastructure to execute it, and expand our impact on campuses across the country. This role reports to the Chief Executive Officer.

This is an opportunity for a senior sales leader who wants ownership over how a sales org is built, not just how it's run. You'll be accountable for revenue results, but you'll also shape org design, compensation strategy, and the long-term GTM architecture that determines how Packback scales.

Who is the ideal candidate?

  • You have experience leading enterprise sales organizations in EdTech, higher education, or another mission-driven B2B SaaS environment at the VP level or equivalent, and you've owned a sales org's structure and economics, not just its quota
  • You enjoy balancing strategy with execution — designing GTM motions and comp plans one day, joining a customer call or coaching a rep through a tough deal the next
  • You're comfortable operating as an executive partner to the CEO, translating market and pipeline data into strategy the leadership team and board can act on
  • You're motivated by building something meaningful and are excited by the opportunity to help colleges and universities improve student learning outcomes

What you'll do

  • Revenue Strategy & GTM Execution: Own the overarching sales strategy for the enterprise and B2C higher-ed business. Design and evolve go-to-market motions, organizational structure, staffing plans, and incentive structures in partnership with Finance and People to drive scalable growth.
  • Team Leadership & Talent Development: Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Executives and front-line managers. Drive a high-performance culture through structured coaching on complex, multi-stakeholder deals—from discovery through close—and proactively recruit and onboard top sales talent. You’ll directly manage both front line managers as well as some enterprise sales representatives.
  • Sales Operations & Pipeline Management: Enforce forecast rigor and pipeline hygiene at the organizational level. Implement reliable processes, playbooks, and KPI tracking to ensure accurate forecasting and provide board-ready performance insights to the executive team.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment & Market Strategy: Drive deep alignment with Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to optimize the end-to-end customer journey. Act as a market advocate, gathering insights from campus leaders and faculty to inform product direction and refine market narratives.

Requirements

  • 10+ years sales experience, including 3+ years leading multilayered teams (manager‑ and/or director‑level reports) in B2B SaaS or EdTech businesses

Job Description


Do you have at least 7 years of experience doing complex profee surgical coding?

Do you thrive on the challenge of diving into and researching proper codes to assign to a complex surgical procedure?

Then this position may be for you!

The Senior Professional Coder performs at an advanced level medical coding position and serves as an expert utilizing ICD-10 and CPT4 classification system coding to all diagnoses, treatments and procedures in all types of Hospital, Clinic and Ambulatory Surgical Center (ASC) locations at stated minimum performance levels. In addition, the Senior Professional Coder provides coding insight and guidance to clinical staff, Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI), Professional Coder 1 and Professional Coder II positions as well as Revenue Cycle leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assign and sequence all ICD-10; CPT 4; Healthcare Common Procedure Coding (HCPC) and modifier codes for services rendered accurately and completely

  • Reconcile correct coding edits and discrepancies prior to final coding

  • Maintain coding quality of 95% or higher while meeting established productivity requirements based on encounter type

  • Follows coding guidelines and legal requirements to ensure compliance with federal and state regulations

  • Identify trends in documentation deficiencies and communicates areas of improvement opportunities to leadership and/or providers

  • Acts as a key liaison for the physicians and clinical staff as it relates to coding and compliance

  • Interacts with physicians and other professional staff of documentation issues relating to coding data

  • Acts as a mentor to Coder I and Coder 2 staff

  • Provides system and workflow training to newly employed coders

  • Prepares and presents education in conjunction with the Revenue Integrity Professional Coding Educator

  • Primary contact for Revenue Cycle team throughout Shriners Hospitals for Children (SHC) system to assist with coding questions

  • Act as back up for Revenue Integrity Professional Coding Lead

Required Qualifications:

  • 7 years of coding experience in inpatient/outpatient professional surgery

  • Experience with Surgery Coding guidelines, E/M Coding Guidelines, CPT Coding, ICD-10, Modifiers, HCPCS and CCI edits

  • Pediatric, orthopedic and/or injury coding experience

  • Experience with education and presentations

  • Functional knowledge of Medical Terminology

  • Functional knowledge of professional coding practice standards

  • Functional knowledge of MS Office

  • High School Diploma or GED

  • Current CCS-P (AHIMA) or CPC (AAPC)

Within ES&O, the HR Compliance team serves as Zillow's center of expertise for HR compliance — establishing the standards, guardrails, and governance frameworks that keep people practices legally sound as the business grows. The team partners closely with the broader People organization, Legal, and other shared services to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical guidance, enabling operational teams to execute compliantly and consistently.

About the role

The Program Manager, HR Compliance is a subject matter expert responsible for helping strengthen Zillow's HR compliance program across a defined and expanding portfolio of programs.

This role supports regulatory monitoring, risk assessment, and policy governance work that allows the team to monitor and respond to changes in employment laws and regulations, identify, assess, and mitigate compliance risk, and equip HR partners with the guidance they need to operate compliantly. You will establish standards, playbooks, and controls for teams to execute against.

You Will:

  • Monitor new and emerging employment regulations across U.S. federal, state, and international jurisdictions

  • Develop and maintain a compliance register and ownership mapping, ensuring risks and obligations are documented, assigned, and tracked

  • Develop and maintain compliance playbooks and operating standards that serve as the authoritative reference for operational teams executing programs

  • Support international employment compliance governance across multiple jurisdictions, partnering with regional HR and People Legal on country-specific regulatory obligations

  • Maintain audit-ready compliance controls and documentation across the program portfolio; coordinate internal and external audit activity, owning documentation standards, evidence organization, and audit response coordination in partnership with People Legal

  • Support preparation and submission of statutory government reports, including mandated federal and state workforce filings

  • Serve as a subject matter expert and advisory resource for stakeholder teams on compliance requirements

  • Establish and communicate the compliance guardrails that operational teams execute against, ensuring consistent application of standards across programs

  • Support development and implementation of actionable, accessible guidance

  • Contribute to compliance education efforts, helping stakeholders understand the intent and practical application of requirements

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $90,900.00 - $145,100.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $86,300.00 - $137,900.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • You treat compliance as a discipline with standards, not a set of tasks to complete. You understand the regulatory intent behind requirements and can communicate it clearly to partners who don't work in this space

  • You are skilled at identifying risk before it becomes an issue, and you know how to document, escalate, and track it with rigor.

  • You draw a clear line between setting the standard and executing against it, and you hold that line in how you structure partnerships with operational teams.

  • You work confidently across jurisdictions and regulatory frameworks, and you know when a question requires legal escalation versus when you can resolve it directly.

  • You build credibility through accuracy, follow-through, and the quality of your documentation.

  • You are organized and deadline-driven, and you can manage multiple programs simultaneously without details falling through.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in HR compliance, employment law operations, or a related field with direct exposure to compliance program management

  • Working knowledge of U.S. employment laws and regulatory frameworks, including FLSA, EEO, FCRA, and related requirements

  • Experience with compliance risk identification, gap assessment, or audit coordination

  • Demonstrated ability to manage HR policy governance processes, including review cycles, version control, and legal alignment

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with a track record of managing multiple concurrent compliance programs

  • Experience with Workday or a comparable HRIS

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with international employment compliance

  • Experience supporting HR compliance programs in a multi-jurisdictional or global environment

  • Background in audit readiness, regulatory response, or compliance documentation standards

  • Experience developing compliance playbooks, standard operating procedures, or governance frameworks used by HR partner or operational teams

​Transferable Skills

Here at Zillow - we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. Responsibilities

Strategic Planning and Execution:

  • Contribute to the development of the company’s long-term strategy by providing operational insights and recommendations.
  • Translate strategic goals into actionable plans for the operations team.

  • Provide leadership and direction for daily operational activities across departments.
  • Monitor performance metrics, ensuring operational goals align with the company’s strategic objectives.
  • Address operational challenges promptly to maintain seamless workflow and productivity.
  • Manage resource allocation to optimize efficiency and support business priorities.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to streamline operations and eliminate redundancies.
  • Lead the adoption of tools and technologies to enhance operational efficiency and reporting.

  • Establish standardized processes, procedures, and policies to ensure consistency and scalability across operations.
  • Regularly review and update processes to align with evolving business needs and industry best practices.
  • Ensure employees are trained and equipped to adhere to established operational guidelines.

  • Supervise production teams and processes to meet client requirements and maintain high-quality standards.

  • Implement quality control measures and continuously seek client feedback to enhance satisfaction.

Team Leadership and Development:

  • Foster a collaborative and results-oriented culture that encourages accountability and innovation.
  • Provide regular feedback, coaching, and professional development opportunities for team members.

Performance Analysis and Reporting:

  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate operational efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Prepare and present performance reports to the executive team, highlighting successes, challenges, and areas for improvement.
  • Use data-driven insights to guide decision-making and strategic planning.

Risk Management and Compliance:

  • Identify potential operational risks and implement strategies to mitigate them.
  • Ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and company policies across all operational activities.
  • Maintain and enforce safety standards to protect employees and assets.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Partner with leadership in finance, marketing, sales, and other departments to align operational goals with overall business strategies.
  • Facilitate communication and coordination between teams to ensure smooth execution of company initiatives.

Budget Management:

  • Develop and manage operational budgets, ensuring alignment with company financial goals.
  • Monitor expenses and implement cost-control measures to maintain profitability.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement by encouraging innovation and adaptability.
  • Stay informed about industry trends and emerging technologies to keep the company competitive.

Skills and Competencies

  • Strategic and Operational Leadership: Ability to translate company goals into clear production priorities, workflows, and measurable outcomes.
  • Team and Resource Management: Ability to develop high-performing teams and effectively manage capacity, workloads, deadlines, and accountability.
  • Process and Quality Management: Ability to improve operational efficiency while maintaining consistent quality and reducing errors, delays, and rework.
  • Data-Driven Collaboration: Strong financial, analytical, communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional decision-making skills.

Requirements

Preferred Qualifications

***MUST HAVE previous experience working at a digital marketing agency***

  • Minimum 3-5 years of proven experience in a digital marketing agency environment, preferably with home improvement or contractor clients
  • Leadership experience in production, operations, project management, or service delivery, preferably within a digital marketing agency or client-service environment.
  • Proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams, multiple client projects, production schedules, and team capacity.
  • Experience developing scalable workflows, quality-control procedures, performance metrics, and operational improvement initiatives.
  • Experience managing departmental budgets, labor costs, resource allocation, utilization, and production profitability.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, operations management, project management, marketing, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with SEO, paid advertising, website development, reporting, and automation.
  • Experience managing remote or internationally distributed teams and using project-management, workflow, and reporting platforms.
  • Familiarity with process documentation, artificial intelligence, automation tools, or relevant project-management and operations certifications.

What We Offer

Work Environment

  • Remote Flexibility: Fully remote position.
  • Growth Opportunity: Join a fast-growing company with significant advancement potential
  • Values-Driven Culture: Work in an environment that champions Ownership, Continuous Improvement, Adaptability, and Drive
  • Inclusive Team: Collaborative, supportive team environment that encourages diverse perspectives

Benefits

  • Client Relationship: You will be directly working with the client. This means that you will communicate with the client, provide services, and address any client-related matters independently.
  • Payments: All payments for your services will be handled by the client. Elevate and Delegate is not involved in processing your payroll. Your salary will directly go to you.
  • Vacation Leaves and Holidays: While we may have recommendations or guidelines regarding vacation leaves and holidays, the decision is entirely at the discretion of the client. You are expected to align your schedule with the client’s business needs and any specific policies or preferences they may have in this regard.

---

Application Process:
