raw.description:
Commercial Project Delivery Director

BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF SUNSTRONG MANAGEMENT

SunStrong Management is a leading independent asset management and servicing platform specializing in residential and commercial solar energy portfolios. SunStrong provides end-to-end services including operations and maintenance, customer billing and support, asset performance management, and investor reporting. The company partners with leading capital providers to optimize clean energy assets at scale, supporting the growth of distributed renewable energy while delivering reliable performance and exceptional customer experience


THE COMMERCIAL PROJECT DELIVERY DIRECTOR POSITION

SunStrong Management is seeking a remote Commercial Project Delivery Director. SunStrong delivers technical asset management and operations for a renewable portfolio spanning solar, battery energy storage, wind, and EV infrastructure. Project Delivery reports into Commercial Operations by design: the organization that will operate an asset for thirty years controls the standard by which it is accepted at twelve months.
The Commercial Project Delivery Director owns the execution of SunStrong's construction and capital project portfolio and the quality of every asset handed to Operations. The role is accountable for schedule, cost, safety, and — distinctively — for the long-term operability of what gets built. It carries commercial ownership of EPC relationships, gate discipline across the delivery path, and the capability of the delivery team.
Part of this will be to create protocols, reporting and other organizational processes where none currently exist. This is not a scheduling or reporting role. The Director is expected to hold a gate against schedule pressure, to refuse an incomplete turnover package, and to defend a punchlist category on the record with a contractor who would prefer it to be dropped.

COMMERCIAL PROJECT DELIVERY DIRECTOR RESPONSIBILITIES

Delivery Governance

  • Own the Project Delivery to Operations Protocol — maintain it, enforce it, and revise it against what each project cycle exposes.
  • Serve as decision authority at Gates 0, 2, and 6; support the VP of Commercial Operations at Gate 5 Operability Acceptance with a documented recommendation and risk position.
  • Resolve punchlist category disputes on the record; escalate to the VP any request to waive a Category A item.
  • Maintain the portfolio gate forecast and surface projected holds early enough that they are decisions rather than emergencies.
  • Establish and maintain the fleet equipment standard and the operability review checklist in partnership with Portfolio Management and Field Service.

FSP Commercial Ownership

  • Own the commercial relationship with Field Service Partners — selection, negotiation support, performance management, and escalation.
  • Direct contract abstraction and ensure Baseline Exposures are identified, owned, and mitigated before a project advances.
  • Negotiate change orders within delegated authority; prepare and defend positions above that threshold.
  • Maintain the FSP performance scorecard and translate it into award decisions, negotiated terms, and surveillance intensity on subsequent projects.
  • Pursue performance guarantee, warranty, workmanship, and latent defect claims in coordination with Legal and Asset Management before claim windows expire.

Portfolio Execution

  • Own aggregate schedule, cost, and cost-to-complete across the delivery portfolio; approve baseline changes.
  • Allocate Project Managers and Project Controls resources against project complexity, exposure, and geography.
  • Chair the weekly internal delivery standup and the monthly owner project review.
  • Own the delivery risk register and drive mitigation to closure rather than to documentation.
  • Interface with Asset Management on COD-dependent lender, tax equity, and host obligations, and Finance on capital forecasting and cash flow.

Safety and Quality

  • Establish the owner-side safety expectation for EPC and subcontractor personnel; verify that stop-work authority is real on every site.
  • Ensure incident and near-miss investigation quality meets SSM standards regardless of which party performed the work.
  • Direct the Inspection and Test Plan review process and the designation of hold and witness points across the portfolio.
  • Drive quality trending — punchlist volume normalized to MW, recurrence rate, nonconformance disposition — into contractor selection and design standards.

Organizational Leadership

  • Build and develop the Project Delivery team — hiring, leveling, development plans, and succession.
  • Establish competency standards for advancement within the Project Manager ladder and the Project Controls track.
  • Drive the working relationship between Project Delivery and Operations so that operability input arrives at design review, not at turnover.
  • Represent Project Delivery to GoodFinch, lenders, tax equity partners, and host customers.


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
  • Ten or more years in construction or project delivery within energy, utility, or infrastructure, including five or more years leading project managers.
  • Demonstrated ownership of utility-scale or distributed generation construction portfolios, with direct EPC contract administration experience.
  • Working command of EPC agreement structure — substantial and final completion, performance guarantees, liquidated damages, retainage, warranty, and change control.
  • Direct experience with commissioning, capacity and performance testing, and turnover acceptance.
  • Demonstrated ability to hold a commercial position with a contractor under schedule pressure.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.


Preferred Qualifications
  • Solar PV and battery energy storage delivery experience; familiarity with tracker, inverter, and BESS platform differences and their operational consequences.
  • Prior operations or asset management experience — the perspective this role is built to import into construction.
  • PMP, or PSP / CCP through AACE International.
  • Experience with acquired or in-flight construction portfolios and the transition of contractor relationships mid-project.
  • Interconnection, AHJ, and utility coordination experience across multiple jurisdictions.



Benefits
SunStrong Management offers a rich and affordable Health & Wellness Benefits package that includes:
  • PPO and HDHP Medical Plans, buy-up plans for both Dental and Vision, ancillaries such as Accident, Critical illness, Hospital indemnity, Employer sponsored Short Term and Long-Term Disability, Voluntary Life, and Legal services along with multiple add-ons.
  • Our 401(k) Package includes a Safe Harbor Match of 100% up to the first 4% and 50% on the next 2% with immediate vesting.

raw.title: Technical Co-founder (CTO) - AI for Automotive Retail
raw.excerpt: The OpportunityEvery used-car dealer's profit is made or lost the moment they buy the car — not when they sell it.
raw.description:
The Opportunity

Every used-car dealer's profit is made or lost the moment they buy the car — not when they sell it. That decision runs on gut feel, spreadsheets, and whoever has a spare hour, inside a $500B+ industry that hasn't meaningfully modernized how it buys. We think that's an AI-native category waiting to be built, and we're going first.

The problem and solution are validated with a domain co-founder who lives this daily and has already hand

The Venture

Atrium is an always-on AI workforce, not a dashboard — agents that watch, learn, and earn the right to act on their own, deployed inside dealer groups' existing workflows. The same decision logic has to show up everywhere the work already happens — web, desktop, our own browser, mobile — so the workforce follows the person, not the other way around. One brain, every surface.

This isn't a weekend's worth of CRUD. Think dozens of specialist agents organized into a handful of coordinated workflows, sharing one memory, each one earning the right to act on its own track record — across four surfaces at once. If that sounds like a fun problem rather than a scary one, keep reading.

A real technical moat if built right, and a wide-open field — no dominant AI-native player has claimed this category yet. Specifics on the product, the model, and where we stand commercially are best shared in conversation; we're early and staying deliberately quiet in the market.

The Partnership

CEO and domain co-founder are in place; the problem is validated. We're looking for a technical co-founder to own product and engineering from the first commit — full authority, founder equity, a real seat at the table on every major call.

This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will take over the production code and continue building the product (the first lines of production code), set the technical direction, and lead execution end-to-end.

  • Own the core architecture decision that shapes everything else — how the agents actually see and act in a dealer's world, and how one system stays coherent across a web app, a desktop app, our own browser, and mobile, without four separate products drifting apart
  • Design the autonomy model: how an agent earns the right to act alone, and how that trust is never assumed
  • Build the integration layer into a data ecosystem that won't always cooperate
  • Build partnerships with ecosystem data providers and third-party systems to land unconventional integrations no standard API gets you
  • Own unit economics as an architecture problem, not an afterthought — this many agents, across this many surfaces, has to add up
  • Own the design and layering of the system for the dev team, and keep the build matched to what the business and sales side actually need
  • Be the technical voice with dealers, design partners, and investors
  • Hire and lead the founding engineering team

Co-Founder Profile

Must Have:

  • Has shipped agentic or LLM systems into production where being wrong actually costs something
  • Has shipped desktop and mobile apps connected to a larger web platform — comfortable with one product living across multiple facets and surfaces, not just a single app
  • Has shipped LLM-based products, but also worked with SLMs and SLM fine-tuning
  • Has dealt with the real nuances of web scraping — anti-bot defences, rate limits, brittle DOMs, the gap between "works in a demo" and "works at scale against a site that doesn't want you there"
  • Has built complex, modelled data graph layers for intelligence — not just a data pipeline, but a structure that reasoning can actually run on
  • Comfortable owning infra, data, and product alone — then hiring past yourself
  • Treats guardrails and reversibility as core product, not overhead
  • Good to have: edge computing and power-constrained systems, high-frequency distributed computing infrastructure

Great to Have:

  • Experience building against locked-down or adversarial third-party data
  • Vertical/operational domain grit (Automotive)
  • Pragmatic and creative — a solution finder who gets to "working" fast and iterates from there
  • Co-operative, strategic, and hands-on in equal measure

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Valkyrie Aero is seeking a software engineer to develop computer vision and sensor fusion software for an airborne mission system. WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Fuse inputs from multiple sensors into a single track picture
  • Design, train, and evaluate models against latency and accuracy targets for embedded deployment
  • Optimize inference on embedded hardware, including pruning, quantization, and TensorRT
  • Develop and maintain the dataset pipeline, including collection, labeling, curation, augmentation, synthetic data, and retraining from field data

  • Support integration and test, including diagnosing and resolving issues on target hardware

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months.

  • Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings.

  • €500 home-office budget and a great laptop.

  • A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", so now and then.

  • Fully remote, within Europe.

Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR.

About us

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. We work according to Holacracy: little hierarchy, lots of ownership. Serious work. Serious fun.

About Terminal.exe

Terminal.exe is All Your BI's SaaS platform for container terminals. It unifies fragmented data, TOS, maintenance, gate, sensors, into one governed model, so every site works from the same numbers instead of rebuilding its own reporting from scratch. The platform is growing fast. You'll help shape the engineering foundations that need to scale next: multi-tenant data architecture, near-real-time pipelines from 24/7 operations, and a standardized data model that works across terminals worldwide.

What the job looks like

You will design and build the pipelines that move data from terminal operating systems (such as Navis N4) into our platform, and the transformation layer that turns raw operational data into curated, documented datasets.

Concretely, you will work on:

  • ELT pipelines from on-premises terminal databases into our Azure-based platform, with near-real-time refresh (3-minute microbatch) for operational reporting and daily batch for analytics. Extraction uses watermark-based incremental queries over Kafka (Azure Event Hubs) to PostgreSQL staging.

  • A multi-tenant data architecture on Azure PostgreSQL with database-per-tenant isolation and a standardized STG → ODS → DataMart layer structure driven by our internal declarative transformation framework (dewi)

  • Our internal connector tooling written in Go, which you will help develop and extend

  • Data quality monitoring: gap detection, freshness alerting, and reconciliation

  • The standardized terminal data model: mapping source data from different TOS versions and configurations onto shared definitions of moves, calls, and equipment events

You will work directly with terminal operations staff, without intermediate layers.

Requirements

What you bring

  • Attitude and experience: curiosity and a genuine appetite for architectural ownership, and 5+ years of data engineering experience, including end-to-end ownership of production data platforms. This is a product under active development, we need you comfortable deciding, not just executing.

  • Core stack: strong SQL and Python; Go experience is a significant plus (our connectors and consumers are written in Go). Solid experience with SQL Server as a source system and PostgreSQL as a target store.

  • Pipelines and streaming: experience building and operating ELT pipelines against operational source systems, including watermark/incremental or CDC/replica-based extraction, and with event-driven or streaming architectures, we use Azure Event Hubs with a Kafka-compatible endpoint.

  • Cloud and observability: cloud data platform experience on Azure, familiarity with AKS, Azure DevOps CI/CD, and GitOps (Argo CD) is a plus, alongside a strong focus on data correctness and instrumentation, we use OpenTelemetry.

  • Nice to have: knowledge of the container terminal or port logistics industry, direct experience with Navis N4 or another TOS, multi-tenant SaaS data architecture experience, and familiarity with declarative, YAML-driven transformation frameworks. Industry knowledge is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, we'll teach you the terminal domain.

We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.

Highlights

Build the pipelines and data model powering a live SaaS platform for container terminals worldwide.

WEX is an innovative payments and technology company leading the way in a rapidly changing environment. Our goal is to simplify the business of running a business for our customers and free them to spend more time, with less worry, on the things they love. We are on a journey to build a unified, world class user experience across our products and services and leverage customer driven innovation to power our growth and strategic initiatives.

As we lean into our mission to “simplify the business of running a business”, WEX is looking to simplify and reimagine experiences, starting from the customer perspective.

As a Product Manager, Unified Platform (Health & Benefits), you will serve as the architectural connective tissue across our Health & Benefits ecosystem. Your mission is to sunset siloed legacy systems and drive the strategy for a seamless, API-first platform. You will own the execution and delivery of the product roadmap by collaborating across the business on the product roadmap with an emphasis on creating a simple, proactive and personalized experience.

About the team:
We are the architects of Wex’s forthcoming unified experience for all Health and Benefits clients. Our mission is to take the complex, siloed worlds of Benefits Administration, Consumer Directed Health (CDH), and Cobra Direct Bill (CDB), and weave them into a single, cohesive ecosystem. We are moving away from fragmented legacy systems toward a modern API-first and Micro-Frontend (MFE) architecture. We operate in a new and at times ambiguous space, tasked with defining the common data standards and seamless workflows that allow our products to feel like one experience, rather than a collection of separate tools.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead the Unification Strategy: Architect the phased transition of Benefits Administration, Consumer Directed Health (CDH), and Cobra Direct Bill (CDB) from siloed legacy tools into a single, cohesive ecosystem.

  • Establish Data-Driven Foundations: Take a proactive approach to our data strategy by identifying missing metrics and designing the instrumentation needed to capture them. You will turn raw information into the insights that justify our roadmap and prove our success.

  • Synthesize Feedback into Action: Use a mix of customer interviews and gathered analytics to validate hypotheses and pivot quickly when a unification effort needs adjustment.

  • Drive Decisive Prioritization: Own the prioritization process by developing a clear point of view on product direction. You will be expected to weigh competing priorities and present a recommended path forward for alignment.

  • Orchestrate API and MFE Strategy: Partner with engineering to ensure our Micro-Frontend (MFE) strategy and backend APIs work in harmony to deliver a modular, "plug-and-play" experience for our users.

  • Standardize Core Logic: Identify and define the shared logic—such as eligibility, enrollment, and identity—that must remain consistent across every product line to ensure a seamless customer journey.

  • Multi-Squad Technical Delivery: Direct 1–3 scrum teams, balancing greenfield builds with legacy migrations while maintaining a relentless focus on feature quality and technical health.

  • Bridge Stakeholder Gaps: Act as the primary link between business leaders, UX, and engineering to ensure everyone is aligned on the unified vision and the trade-offs required to get there.

  • Leverage AI for Efficiency: Use AI tools to accelerate the discovery process, from drafting complex technical requirements, to identifying patterns in large datasets, to building prototypes of new features.

  • Identify Common Denominators: Look across different product tribes to find where we are duplicating effort and lead the charge in consolidating those into shared, scalable services.

What you’ll bring:

  • 4–6+ Years of Product Management Experience: Proven track record owning complex, enterprise-grade platform products (experience in Health, Benefits strongly preferred).

  • API & System Architecture Fluency: Strong functional grasp of how APIs and Micro-Frontends (MFEs) interact to power modular, scalable web apps.

  • Mastery of Ambiguity: Demonstrated ability to take high-level organizational goals and distill them into actionable, step-by-step engineering roadmaps.

  • Systems-Thinking Mindset: Ability to balance micro-level user workflows with macro-level platform architecture.

  • Data-Centric Approach: Comfort with data modeling and establishing single-source-of-truth architectures between disparate systems.

  • Influence & Governance: Exceptional stakeholder management skills with a history of driving consensus across competing organizational priorities.

Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Construction Project Coordinator (Commercial Construction) – Remote

Construction Administration | AIA Billing | Bonding | Buildertrend | Project Coordination

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Construction Project Coordinator to support the successful execution of commercial construction projects from pre-construction through project completion.

This is a detail-driven operations role responsible for managing construction contracts, bonding processes, AIA billing, project documentation, and administrative coordination across multiple active projects. You’ll work closely with project managers, contractors, municipalities, vendors, and clients to ensure projects remain organized, compliant, and on schedule.

If you thrive in structured environments, enjoy coordinating complex construction workflows, and have experience with commercial construction administration, this role offers the opportunity to become an integral part of a growing construction organization.

What You’ll Own

Contracts & Bonding Management

  • Review and manage commercial construction contracts throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Coordinate bid bonds, performance bonds, and maintenance bonds.
  • Prepare and submit bonding documentation accurately and on time.
  • Communicate with bonding companies, municipalities, and general contractors.
  • Track contract compliance and maintain organized project documentation.

AIA Billing & Project Administration

  • Prepare and submit AIA billing packages.
  • Maintain and update Schedule of Values (SOV).
  • Track retainage and project payment milestones.
  • Ensure billing submissions are accurate and completed on schedule.
  • Monitor deadlines and proactively identify potential payment or billing issues.

Buildertrend & Project Systems Management

  • Maintain project documentation within Buildertrend.
  • Track project schedules, milestones, receipts, and progress.
  • Keep project records accurate, organized, and up to date.
  • Maintain CRM and project management system integrity.
  • Support leadership with project reporting and visibility.

Administrative & Project Support

  • Coordinate communication with clients, contractors, vendors, and project stakeholders.
  • Support pre-construction and pre-sales administrative activities.
  • Organize contracts, permits, and project documentation.
  • Assist project managers with operational coordination.
  • Participate in weekly project meetings and provide project updates.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • Experience working with commercial construction contracts.
  • Hands-on experience with AIA billing and payment applications.
  • Experience managing Schedule of Values (SOV).
  • Knowledge of bid bonds, performance bonds, and maintenance bonds.
  • Experience tracking retainage and construction billing documentation.

Core Skills

  • Strong Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office proficiency.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Outstanding organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple construction projects simultaneously.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using Buildertrend or similar construction management software.
  • Background in commercial construction, landscaping, or project management.
  • Experience with CRM and project tracking systems.
  • Basic bookkeeping or accounting experience within construction.
  • Familiarity with construction financial reporting and payment tracking.

Tools & Technologies

  • Buildertrend (Preferred)
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Microsoft Office Suite
  • CRM Systems
  • Construction Project Management Software

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Highly organized and exceptionally detail-oriented.
  • Thrive in structured, deadline-driven environments.
  • Strong ownership mindset with excellent follow-through.
  • Comfortable coordinating multiple moving parts simultaneously.
  • Professional communicator with contractors, municipalities, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Proactively identify and resolve issues before they become problems.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review commercial construction contracts and project documentation.
  • Prepare bonding packages and submit required documentation.
  • Process AIA billing applications and update Schedule of Values.
  • Track retainage, payment milestones, and billing schedules.
  • Update Buildertrend and project management systems.
  • Coordinate with contractors, municipalities, and vendors.
  • Participate in project meetings and communicate status updates.
  • Monitor project deadlines and ensure documentation remains accurate and complete.

In short: You serve as the operational backbone of commercial construction projects, ensuring contracts, billing, documentation, and project coordination remain accurate, compliant, and on schedule.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Accurate and timely AIA billing submissions.
  • Successful management of bonding documentation and deadlines.
  • Accuracy of project records and CRM data.
  • Timely completion of contract administration tasks.
  • Reduced billing delays and payment issues.
  • Effective coordination across multiple active projects.
  • Consistent adherence to project deadlines and documentation requirements.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High-impact role supporting commercial construction projects.
  • Opportunity to work closely with experienced project managers and leadership.
  • Strong ownership over project administration and coordination.
  • Exposure to contracts, bonding, billing, and construction operations.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Clear career progression into:
    • Senior Project Coordinator
    • Construction Operations Manager
    • Project Manager
    • Construction Operations Lead

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Final Client Interview
  4. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you have experience coordinating commercial construction projects, managing contracts and AIA billing, and keeping complex projects organized from start to finish, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become a key contributor to a growing construction team.

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend & Infrastructure)
raw.excerpt: The RoleYou'll own the backend, data, and infrastructure that deliver Forager's data to platform customers at scale — from ingestion all the way through to the APIs and feeds customers integrate against.
raw.description:
The Role

You'll own the backend, data, and infrastructure that deliver Forager's data to platform customers at scale — from ingestion all the way through to the APIs and feeds customers integrate against. This is a backend-first role: most of your time is spent building API features, operating our search and ETL data infrastructure, and owning the DevOps and platform layer underneath it. You'll also contribute to our customer-facing React/TypeScript web app, but that's the minority of the work.

This is a senior, high-ownership role on a small team. You won't just contribute features — you'll be responsible for the design, reliability, and evolution of the platform itself. You'll have direct input into product direction and the freedom (and responsibility) to ship work that materially moves our coverage, accuracy, latency, and uptime metrics.

What You'll Own

Ranked by where your time goes:

  • Backend & API development — real-time enrichment APIs (person/org lookup, contact data, reverse search), search and filter endpoints, waterfall enrichment logic, and the credit/billing surfaces customers meter against. Match rate, latency, and freshness directly drive customer value.
  • Data engineering, ETL & search infrastructure — own the Elasticsearch/ECK stack end-to-end (index and mapping design, ingestion pipelines, relevance tuning, cluster health, scaling, migrations), plus the ETL applications that move billions of data points daily into searchable stores, Snowflake data products, and warehouse exports while holding fill rates and accuracy.
  • DevOps & platform (core owner) — you own day-to-day AWS infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, and observability. This is not shared-on-the-side ops: you're responsible for infrastructure modernization, deployment pipelines, security scanning, log/metric consolidation, and the reliability of the systems you build.
  • Observability & data-quality tooling — build Grafana dashboards, load tests, and data-accuracy evals that make coverage, freshness, latency, and correctness measurable and continuously monitored across the data-quality surface.
  • Customer-facing web app (minority) — contribute to the React/TypeScript app, docs, onboarding, and self-serve surfaces when the work calls for it.

Core Responsibilities

Backend & API Development

  • Design, build, and operate RESTful APIs for enrichment, search, feeds, and platform-customer workflows.
  • Develop scalable backend services — workers, task queues, waterfall lookups, data pipelines — that keep refresh cycles predictable and fill rates high.
  • Build the metering, credit-logging, and billing logic that customers rely on for accurate consumption.
  • Participate actively in product planning; help shape which features have the highest customer impact.

Data Engineering, Search & ETL

  • Own the Elasticsearch / ECK search stack end-to-end: index design, ingestion, relevance, cluster health, scaling, and migrations.
  • Design and operate ETL applications moving data into searchable stores, bulk feeds, and warehouses (Snowflake, S3).
  • Optimize PostgreSQL — query performance, indexing, cache utilization.
  • Drive measurable improvements in latency, uptime, error rate, fill rate, and scalability.

DevOps & Infrastructure (Core Owner)

  • Own AWS infrastructure (ECS, S3, etc.) and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Own CI/CD pipelines.
  • Own observability — Grafana, CloudWatch, Sentry — and on-call response for the surfaces you build.
  • Drive infrastructure modernization and share crawler infrastructure maintenance with the team.

Collaboration & Quality

  • Code review with high standards for readability, security, and performance.
  • Write unit, integration, and E2E tests — test reliability is a quality contributor, not overhead.
  • Document features, architecture, and API contracts; great developer docs are how our customers succeed.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems and APIs, with clear examples of strategic technical problem-solving (not just tenure).
  • Strong proficiency in Python / Django REST Framework.
  • Hands-on experience operating Elasticsearch / OpenSearch at scale — index/mapping design, query and relevance tuning, cluster management, migrations.
  • Demonstrated track record building and operating ETL pipelines that move significant data volumes reliably.
  • Production experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, and async task systems (Celery / RabbitMQ or equivalent).
  • Core-owner-level comfort with AWS (ECS, S3, CloudWatch), infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions or equivalent) — you're comfortable owning the platform, not just deploying to it.
  • Experience operating services in production — observability, on-call, incident response.
  • Working proficiency in React / TypeScript — comfortable shipping product UI when the work calls for it. (This is the minority of the role, not its center.)
  • Strong written communication; comfortable owning documentation as a deliverable.

AI & Agentic Workflows (Required)

This is non-negotiable. AI coding tools are core to how we build, and you're expected to operate effectively in an AI-augmented engineering environment. You must demonstrate strong, hands-on fluency with:

  • AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent) used daily for implementation, refactoring, and code review — while validating all generated output before it reaches production.
  • Agentic workflows — designing, orchestrating, and debugging multi-step agent pipelines (e.g., research → plan → implement → verify loops, MCP server integration, tool-use design).
  • Judgment about where AI helps vs. hurts — knowing when to delegate to an agent, when to write the code yourself, and how to keep an agent on rails for production work.

We evaluate this in interviews with live exercises. Candidates without demonstrable agentic workflow experience will not be considered.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Snowflake or other data warehouses.
  • Background in B2B data products — enrichment, contact data, company data, search/discovery.
  • Experience with data-privacy/compliance engineering — GDPR/PII handling, US state privacy regimes.
  • Building MCP servers.
  • Experience with web crawling, data sourcing, or large-scale ingestion systems.
  • Open-source contributions or public technical writing.

Benefits

  • Competitive pay for your location — calibrated to your experience and where you're based.
  • Flexible working hours — we care about output and overlap, not clock-watching.
  • Untracked PTO — take the time off you need; there's no accrual to count.
  • Relaxed working environment — small team, high autonomy, low bureaucracy. Anyone can take an idea to production without jumping through hoops.

LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Mandarin-English Video-Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Mandarin Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Video-Phone Interpreter

Pay: $23 - $25 per hour.

  • Compensation will not be less than any applicable state or local minimum wage.

We Offer:

  • Paid professional interpreter training and continuous development.
  • Incentives for meeting attendance targets.
  • Benefits include: Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable law, Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Accident, Critical Illness & Life, AD&D, Insurance Package, Inpatient Hospital, Short Term Disability, and 401K Retirement.
  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.

Position Overview:

The Mandarin Video-Telephone- Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Mandarin and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**

Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.
  • Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inMandarin and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages – highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer and webcam the majority of the workday.
  • Must use a headset for prolonged periods of time.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

Applications will be accepted for Thirty (30) days from the posting date of September 11, 2026.

EEO/AA

LLS is an equal opportunity employer, meaning that employment opportunities are made and offered to individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or any other characteristic protected by federal or state law or local ordinance. LLS will reasonably accommodate employees and applicants with disabilities if the person is otherwise qualified to safely perform all of the essential functions of the position. Should you require accommodations to complete this application and/or the interview process, please let us know immediately.

Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race. color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, pregnancy, genetic information or any other consideration prohibited by law or contract.

Compliance with Disability Laws. It is also our policy to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in all aspects of the employment process. We are prepared to modify or adjust the job application process or the job or work environment to make reasonable accommodations to the known physical or mental limitations of the applicant or employee to enable the applicant or employee to be considered for the position he or she desires, to perform the essential functions of the position in question, or to enjoy equal benefits and privileges of employment as are enjoyed by other similarly situated employees without disabilities, unless the accommodation will impose an undue hardship.

The Senior Process Improvement Professional will lead the design and implementation of new operational processes to support interoperability and medical documentation chase work. The Senior Process Improvement Professional will work across business, product, and IT teams to stand up new capabilities, improve end-to-end process performance, and ensure processes are scalable, compliant, and operationally sustainable. Work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where independent judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and deep process analysis are required.

*** This position is created specifically to assist with Humana's efforts to secure and, if awarded, transition into a new business opportunity. Please note that continued employment in this role is expressly contingent upon Humana's receipt of the business opportunity and a satisfactory transition into the work. In the event Humana does not pursue the opportunity or determines that a timely and satisfactory transition cannot be achieved, employment may be subject to termination. ***

In this remote position you will report to the VP, VA CCN Program Leader.
As the Deputy VA CCN Program Leader, you will serve as a key member of the VA leadership team, directly supporting the VA CCN Program Leader (VPL) in providing overall management, execution, and operational performance of the Department of Veteran Affairs (VA) Community Care Network program.
You will support the VP, VPL in providing strategic and operational leadership to ensure contract compliance, service delivery, and support for Veteran's, providers, and VA stakeholders. The Deputy VPL serves as a liaison across cross-functional teams and helps drive improvement, operational excellence, and achievement of program objectives.

Job Description

The Senior Process Improvement Professional serves as the end-to-end process owner and subject matter expert for interoperability and medical documentation chase operations. This role will assess business needs, design new workflows, define operating models, and develop process standards, controls, and performance measures to support successful implementation. The associate will partner closely with business stakeholders, product teams, and IT to document requirements for system functionality, identify dependencies, and ensure technology solutions align to operational needs.

The Senior Process Improvement Professional will map current and future-state processes, identify gaps, risks, and opportunities, and recommend sustainable solutions that improve accuracy, efficiency, and stakeholder experience. This role will help establish business rules, intake requirements, routing logic, exception handling, reporting needs, and governance processes for new work. The associate will also support change management, implementation planning, testing, and operational readiness activities to ensure successful launch and adoption.

The role requires developing deep expertise across the full end-to-end process, including upstream inputs, downstream impacts, stakeholder roles, system touchpoints, and compliance considerations. The Senior Process Improvement Professional makes decisions on moderately complex to complex issues regarding process design, requirements, and implementation approach, and performs work with limited direction while exercising considerable latitude in determining objectives and methods.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Lead the design and stand-up of new processes supporting interoperability and medical documentation chase operations, including defining the end-to-end operating model and implementation approach
  • Build and maintain end-to-end workflows, including intake, triage, routing, exception handling, escalation paths, and reporting requirements
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for the full operational process and associated system interactions, ensuring strong understanding of upstream inputs and downstream impacts
  • Partner with business, product, and IT stakeholders to gather, document, and refine business and system requirements for new functionality
  • Translate operational needs into functional requirements, business rules, user stories, process maps, and supporting documentation
  • Facilitate cross-functional working sessions to define current-state, future-state, and target-state processes; identify gaps, risks, controls, and dependencies across teams and systems
  • Recommend and implement sustainable process improvements that improve efficiency, quality, scalability, and operational readiness
  • Support solution design, testing, training, SOP/job aid development, and change readiness activities for new process launches and enhancements

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
  • Experience standing up new processes, workflows, or operating models from the ground up
  • Experience gathering, documenting, and refining business and system requirements
  • Experience working cross-functionally with business, product, and IT stakeholders
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including process documentation and executive-ready materials
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including identifying process gaps, risks, and dependencies
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. 40

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. Department Overview

Department: Technical Documentation Team for Video Security and Access Control
Do you love taking on tough challenges? We need a dedicated technical writer, who is all about the customer. Motorola Solutions is seeking a dynamic, self-motivated, and enthusiastic technical writer. As the primary writer owning one or more documentation portfolios end-to-end, you will drive the entire content lifecycle from initial requirements gathering and scoping, to architecting the information, executing deliverables, publishing, and long-term maintenance.


Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Writer to develop, maintain, and enhance user-facing documentation across multiple delivery platforms, including web-based portals, multimedia, and embedded assistance technologies. In this role, you will lead documentation efforts for new products, major releases, and product redesigns, ensuring our content maximizes usability and customer satisfaction.

Beyond content creation, you will serve as a key contributor to team excellence by mentoring junior writers, streamlining documentation workflows, and advocating for user-centric design across cross-functional teams, including Development, UX, and Technical Support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Documentation Excellence: Plan, write, and edit high-impact documentation for diverse product ecosystems, ensuring consistency and effectiveness across all delivery formats.

  • Product Documentation Ownership: Serve as the primary lead for an assigned brand or product line, taking full accountability for the end-to-end documentation lifecycle. Drive doc strategy and manage release deliverables to ensure comprehensive content coverage across all product milestones.

  • Customer Advocacy: Prioritize the customer experience by approaching technical content with a user-first, problem-solving mindset.

  • Team Leadership & Mentorship: Act as a subject matter expert, advising Technical Writer I and II levels, maintaining rigorous quality standards, and assisting with workload distribution.

  • Process Optimization: Continuously audit team processes and deliverables. Proactively develop, communicate, and implement initiatives to enhance efficiency and usability both within the team and across the broader organization.

  • Content Triage & Support: Own the documentation bug/support pipeline: triage reports, clarify requirements, ensure accurate assignments, and escalate critical issues to the Manager or appropriate product teams.

  • Strategic Collaboration: Build consensus across organizational levels to align documentation strategies with business objectives. Resolve complex job- or customer-related issues creatively and independently.

  • Technical Proficiency: Maintain advanced knowledge of authoring tools and workflows, proactively applying this expertise to improve team deliverables.

Qualifications

  • Authoring Expertise: Demonstrated proficiency in Madcap Flare authoring and advanced documentation workflows.

  • Publication Strategy: Proven experience with diverse publication types, including online content syndication and HTML-first documentation (prioritizing the "every page is page one" approach).

  • Collaboration: Skilled at building consensus and working effectively across separate, cross-functional teams.

  • AI Integration: Ability to leverage AI-powered tools to drive quality and operational efficiency.

  • Tooling: Familiarity with Jira and Confluence for task and documentation management.

Preferred Skills (Competitive Advantages)

  • Lifecycle Management: Experience navigating the complexities of creating and maintaining standardized manuals for hardware/software throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Efficiency Mindset: A history of driving significant process improvements and operational efficiency.

  • Technical Tools: Proficiency in git-based source control and Adobe Creative Cloud, specifically Adobe Illustrator.

  • Technical Writing Background: Deep experience acting as a customer advocate and translating complex technical concepts into intuitive user guides.


Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree with 5+ years of experience in technical writing or equivalent discipline experience OR 8+ years of technical writing experience.

  • Legal authorization to work in Canada indefinitely is required. Employer work permit sponsorship is not available for this position.

Under 10%

  • Proven experience in customer acquisition, client outreach, sales, or marketing roles

Key Skills

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

Developing our people is critical to our strategy and fostering our culture of empowerment.

A Brief Overview

The US LBM Lead Software Engineer (Order-to-Cash) will provide technical leadership while working hands-on alongside software engineers developing highly available applications, APIs, and integrations across US LBM's order-to-cash platform, billing, credit, collections, cash application, and financial reconciliation.


This role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership, product partnership, and business engagement. The Engineering Lead will partner with Product Managers, Architects, and business stakeholders to align technology delivery with business objectives and guide teams through design, development, deployment, and support.


Above all, this is a builder's role at the leading edge of US LBM's move to an AI-First software development lifecycle. Partnering closely with the Product Manager, the Lead Engineer will own use-case discovery and rapid prototyping, quickly turning ideas into working proof-of-concepts that demonstrate business value across the organization, and will lead their team in adopting AI across how we discover, design, build, test, and ship software. If you want to help define how a 13,000-person company builds software in the AI era, this is that role.


What you will do

  • Partner with the Product Manager to own use-case discovery and rapid prototyping, identifying, testing, and proving out AI and technology opportunities across the organization, and turning them into working proof-of-concepts

Required For All Jobs

  • 5+ years developing and delivering custom web, mobile, enterprise, or integration solutions

  • Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring, code reviews, design guidance, architecture, and delivery ownership
  • Strong hands-on experience building full-stack applications with TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6+), including React on the front end and Node.js on the back end
  • Experience developing back-end services in Python and/or Rust, and working with relational and document databases such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB
  • Experience integrating financial and accounts-receivable systems and building solutions across order-to-cash, billing, credit, collections, cash application, and reconciliation (e.g., Billtrust, Bectran, BlackLine)

raw.description:
Who we are:

We are on a mission to become a leading supplier of critical materials that enable the green energy and technology revolution. Our materials and technologies are required for the electric vehicle, green energy, consumer electronics, and defense industries, and our battery grade lithium and tech metals are needed for chipsets, semiconductors, and 5G.

We have a substantial interest in the Round Top, Heavy Rare Earth, Lithium and Critical Minerals deposit in West Texas. We have also developed the United States’ first rare earth and critical minerals processing facility and we own the only scalable, sintered neo-magnet manufacturing system in the Western Hemisphere. By developing this fully integrated, US-based “mine-to-magnet” critical mineral supply chain, we are poised to become the leading domestic supplier to these industries.

What you can expect:

At USA Rare Earth, we are pioneers and problem solvers, technologists and team players. Together, we:

Build Solutions: If our task was a simple one, it would already be done. We are creative and solution-oriented, and we think outside the box to solve important problems. We know that a range of expertise and technologies is needed for success, and we work across sectors and alongside customers to deliver world-class solutions in sustainable ways.

Deliver Quality: When we do things, we do them well. We believe that top-tier quality leads to industry competitiveness and we hold ourselves to the highest quality standards. We move fast when executing, but safety, quality, and excellence always come first.

Lead responsibly: We have a responsibility to the planet, our consumers, our country, and each other. We put safety at the center of all we do, take accountability for our actions, incorporate sustainable practices in our processes and act with the financial best interest of our investors and consumers in mind.

Win Together: Establishing a rare earth magnet supply chain is a big undertaking – and getting there is a team effort. We communicate openly, work together and challenge each other in pursuit of our goals. With every step we take we learn and get better.

Job Summary:

The Sr. Sales Director, Aerospace & Defense leads USA Rare Earth's commercial growth within the aerospace and defense market. This senior role owns an end-to-end book of business, from strategic account planning and new program capture through demand forecasting and year-over-year account growth. The ideal candidate brings deep aerospace and defense industry relationships, understands long, technical sales and government contracting cycles, and operates independently while collaborating closely with Product Management, Engineering, Operations, and other internal leaders to win and grow programs with OEMs and integrators.

Primary Target Markets:

  • Military aircraft (fixed-wing and rotary)
  • Unmanned aerial systems (UAS/UAVs)
  • Precision-guided munitions and missile systems
  • Ground vehicle actuation and targeting systems
  • Naval propulsion and sonar systems
  • Avionics, radar, and electronic warfare platforms
  • Defense-grade electric actuation and control systems

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Sales Leadership & Account Ownership

  • Identify and engage OEMs and integrators across the focus markets above that integrate rare earth magnets into mission-critical systems.
  • Own and grow an end-to-end book of business within these focus markets, serving as the primary relationship owner for key accounts and target programs.
  • Lead technical sales efforts and manage the full-cycle government contracting process, from initial engagement through program award.
  • Develop and execute account plans aligned to annual revenue targets.
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with customer engineering, procurement, and program management organizations.
  • Guide customers through material qualification and program approval processes, coordinating internal resources to support technical evaluations.
  • Lead development of MOUs, joint development agreements (JDAs), and supply agreements to secure multi-year volume commitments with key customers.
  • Convert early-stage agreements into production slot orders and purchase orders.
  • Represent USA Rare Earth at defense tradeshows, industry briefings, and customer meetings to build brand presence and generate new opportunities.

Demand Planning & Forecasting

  • Own end-to-end demand planning and forecasting for assigned accounts, coordinating closely with Operations, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing to align production capacity with customer program timelines.
  • Deliver monthly forecasting and demand plans, maintaining forecast accuracy of 80% or greater.
  • Translate customer program schedules, ramp curves, and volume forecasts into actionable production plans.
  • Monitor aerospace and defense demand trends, budget cycles, and program awards to inform company-wide planning.

Customer & Pipeline Management (CRM)

  • Maintain rigorous CRM discipline ensuring account, opportunity, and pipeline data reflect current status.
  • Maintain CRM pipeline coverage of 10 times (10x) annual revenue targets to support consistent, predictable growth.
  • Track and report on pipeline health, win and loss trends, and account growth against annual targets.
  • Develop and maintain multi-year account plans and pursuit roadmaps for strategic aerospace and defense customers.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Deal Execution

  • Collaborate with Contracts, Application Engineering, Program Management, Quality, and Operations to ensure compliance and on-time delivery for customer programs.
  • Negotiate and close business under FAR/DFARS-compliant terms, including flow-down clauses and risk mitigation.
  • Lead broader contract negotiations, pricing strategy, and commercial terms for new and renewal business.
  • Coordinate with Marketing on positioning, messaging, and campaign support for the aerospace and defense segment.
  • Partner with executive leadership on strategic planning, market entry, and investment prioritization for the segment.

Market Intelligence & Strategy

  • Monitor the competitive landscape, program timelines, and industry trends within aerospace and defense.
  • Provide voice-of-customer feedback to Product, Engineering, and Leadership to inform roadmap and capacity decisions.
  • Contribute to long-range strategic planning for the aerospace and defense segment.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Proven track record of building and growing complex, technical accounts within long sales-cycle, highly regulated industries.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, comfortable engaging with senior customer and internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage a full sales cycle, from prospecting through contract negotiation and account growth.
  • Skilled in industrial demand planning and forecasting, with the ability to translate customer programs into production-aligned forecasts.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales preferred; Salesforce.com or Hubspot acceptable), with disciplined pipeline management process.
  • Strong collaborator and independent thinker, comfortable operating with autonomy in a fast-paced, growth-stage environment.
  • Working knowledge of aerospace and defense procurement processes, including familiarity with prime contractors, Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers, and government contracting practices (FAR/DFARS).
  • Understanding of export control regulations (ITAR/EAR) as they relate to defense-related sales activities.
  • Familiarity with MIL-SPEC qualification processes and long program qualification cycles.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Engineering or a related field required. MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive commercial or sales experience, including 5+ years focused on aerospace and defense or an adjacent industry.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and growing account revenue year over year.
  • Experience with industrial demand planning and forecasting in a manufacturing or industrial supply environment.
  • Proven CRM proficiency (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales or Salesforce.com).
  • Existing relationships with aerospace and defense primes, Tier 1 or Tier 2 suppliers, or defense agencies strongly preferred.
  • Active or prior security clearance is a plus, though not required.
  • Ability to travel 60% or more to support customer engagements, tradeshows, and other internal meetings.

Physical Demands

The work environment will primarily be a home office or typical office environment, combined with frequent customer-site and travel-related environments. Noise level: normal office noises.

raw.description:
This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform — not a job. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You record, you get paid.

About the Role

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. These videos help train AI systems and robots to understand how people interact with objects in real-world environments.

Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities

  • Record everyday household activities from a first-person perspective — cooking, cleaning, tidying up, folding laundry, gardening, walking the dog, and more
  • Record in your own home, yard, garage, or workspace
  • Follow short recording guidelines per session
  • Upload videos through the project app

Requirements

  • Equipment: Own or use a smartphone or alternative camera device capable of 30 FPS or greater and 1080p resolution or greater. iPhone 12 or newer, Google Pixel 6+, or Samsung Galaxy S21+ (must have a wide-angle / 0.5x lens)
  • Capture method: Mount the device at forehead or eye-level for an egocentric perspective, maintaining a downward angle to maximize hand visibility.
  • Software: Utilize the designated "D&A" application for all data capture and upload.
  • Quality control: Ensure all video footage is clear, stable, well-lit, at least 15 seconds long, and accurately depicts useful, intentional tasks without unnecessary pauses or contrived movements.

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

• Earn while you do your household chores: up to $6 per hour equivalent depending on the project

• This is project-based freelance work — pick up recording sessions when they fit your schedule

• Influence the future of how AI and robots understand and interact with the real world

Candidates must be available to work late afternoon and overnights, including weekends and holidays, to be considered.

Key Responsibilities

  • Update ticketing system based on contract requirements

Founded in 1995 at the start of the dot-com revolution, TechFlow helped large commercial clients such as Dreamworks, Toshiba, MGM, and others modernize their business systems. WordPress Developer – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Remote (LATAM, South Africa, Philippines, Pakistan Preferred)
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a WordPress Developer to build, customize, optimize, and maintain high-performing WordPress websites that support business growth and digital marketing initiatives.

This role combines strong WordPress development expertise with a solid understanding of website performance, SEO, responsive design, and user experience. You’ll work closely with marketing, content, and design teams to develop visually polished, conversion-focused websites that are fast, secure, and easy to maintain.

From custom page builds and plugin integrations to performance optimization and troubleshooting, you’ll own the complete website development lifecycle while ensuring every site delivers an exceptional user experience.

If you’re passionate about WordPress development and enjoy building websites that are both technically sound and marketing-driven, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

WordPress Development & Customization

  • Build and customize WordPress websites using Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Gutenberg, or custom development.
  • Develop and maintain custom WordPress themes and child themes.
  • Create responsive landing pages, blogs, templates, and marketing-focused web pages.
  • Customize layouts and functionality using PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Convert Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch designs into responsive WordPress pages.

Plugin Management & Integrations

  • Install, configure, and customize WordPress plugins including:
    • WooCommerce
    • Yoast SEO
    • Contact Form 7
    • Advanced Custom Fields (ACF)
  • Troubleshoot plugin conflicts and compatibility issues.
  • Extend website functionality through custom PHP development.
  • Integrate CRMs, analytics tools, marketing platforms, and third-party APIs.

Website Performance & SEO Optimization

  • Optimize website speed, Core Web Vitals, and overall performance.
  • Implement:
    • Caching
    • Image optimization
    • Lazy loading
    • CDN integration
    • Code minification
  • Perform website audits using Google Lighthouse, GTmetrix, and PageSpeed Insights.
  • Apply technical SEO best practices, including metadata, schema markup, heading structure, and mobile optimization.

Website Maintenance & Security

  • Manage WordPress core, theme, and plugin updates.
  • Monitor website uptime, backups, and overall website health.
  • Implement security best practices using tools such as Wordfence, Sucuri, or iThemes Security.
  • Troubleshoot bugs, hosting issues, broken layouts, and website errors.
  • Maintain secure, stable, and reliable website environments.

Collaboration & Support

  • Partner with marketing and design teams to launch campaigns and website updates.
  • Support non-technical team members with CMS updates and content management.
  • Maintain organized staging environments and deployment workflows.
  • Document website changes, configurations, and technical processes.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You have strong hands-on WordPress development experience.
  • You care about clean code, responsive layouts, and website performance.
  • You balance technical implementation with marketing and user experience goals.
  • You proactively solve problems and take ownership of website quality.
  • You communicate effectively while working independently in remote teams.
  • You consistently deliver polished, reliable websites.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional WordPress development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in:
    • WordPress
    • PHP
    • HTML
    • CSS
    • JavaScript
  • Experience with page builders such as:
    • Elementor
    • Divi
    • WPBakery
    • Gutenberg
  • Experience managing hosting environments including:
    • WP Engine
    • SiteGround
    • Kinsta
    • cPanel
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Responsive design
    • Cross-browser compatibility
    • Website speed optimization
    • Technical SEO
  • Excellent troubleshooting and debugging skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred Experience

  • WooCommerce development and e-commerce websites.
  • Experience building or extending custom WordPress plugins.
  • Familiarity with Git workflows and staging/deployment environments.
  • Experience integrating APIs, CRMs, or marketing automation platforms.
  • Background working with agencies, SaaS companies, or high-growth businesses.

What Success Looks Like

  • Website projects and updates are delivered on time.
  • Websites consistently load in under three seconds.
  • Strong Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse performance scores.
  • Minimal downtime and security incidents.
  • Responsive, visually polished, and conversion-focused websites.
  • Positive feedback from marketing, design, and leadership teams.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Practical Assessment (Landing Page Build or Website Optimization Task)
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This allows hiring managers to evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re a WordPress Developer who enjoys building fast, secure, and high-performing websites, thrives on solving technical challenges, and wants to create digital experiences that drive business growth, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help build websites that are optimized for performance, usability, and long-term success.
