Summary

Estamos buscando un mecánico de servicio calificado y confiable especializado en automóviles clásicos para unirse a nuestro equipo. Este puesto implica diagnosticar, reparar y realizar mantenimiento rutinario en vehículos clásicos, incluidos autos y camiones ligeros antiguos. El candidato ideal será competente en el uso de herramientas de diagnóstico, realizar reparaciones y asegurarse de que todo el trabajo cumpla con los estándares de seguridad de la industria. Además, el puesto requiere la capacidad de asesorar a los clientes sobre mantenimiento preventivo para preservar el rendimiento y la longevidad de sus vehículos clásicos.

La compensación varía entre $37,440 y $58,240 por año, según la experiencia y la disponibilidad.

Job Specifics

  • Diagnosticar autos clásicos y camiones ligeros utilizando herramientas de diagnóstico modernas.
  • Realizar reparaciones en diversos sistemas del vehículo, como motores, frenos, transmisiones y componentes eléctricos, con enfoque en modelos antiguos.
  • Realizar tareas de mantenimiento rutinario, incluyendo cambios de aceite, rotaciones de llantas, revisión de fluidos y reemplazo de filtros.
  • Asegurarse de que todas las reparaciones y el mantenimiento cumplan con los estándares de seguridad de la industria y las especificaciones del fabricante.
  • Comunicarse con los clientes para ofrecerles asesoramiento sobre mantenimiento preventivo y cuidado de los autos clásicos.
  • Mantener registros precisos de todas las reparaciones, mantenimientos y trabajos de diagnóstico realizados.
  • Mantener un ambiente de trabajo limpio y organizado, siguiendo todos los protocolos de seguridad.

Qualifications and Experience


Qualifications

  • Título de secundaria o GED.
  • Más de 2 años de experiencia en reparación automotriz, con especialización en automóviles clásicos y vehículos antiguos.
  • Dominio en el uso de herramientas de diagnóstico y reparación básica de vehículos antiguos

Experience

  • Certificación ASE (Automotive Service Excellence).
  • Más de 3 años de experiencia en reparación automotriz, con enfoque en automóviles clásicos y vehículos antiguos.
  • Experiencia con diagnósticos avanzados y técnicas de solución de problemas en sistemas de vehículos antiguos.
  • Fuertes habilidades de comunicación para interactuar con los clientes y brindarles recomendaciones de mantenimiento para automóviles clásicos.

Our innovative approach to remote mechanic jobs is reshaping the industry, offering unparalleled opportunities for skilled professionals like you. By joining our team, you'll be at the forefront of this revolution, leveraging cutting-edge technology to provide expert services from anywhere. With flexible schedules and the ability to work remotely, you'll enjoy greater freedom and autonomy in your career. Plus, our commitment to inclusivity ensures that every team member is valued and supported. If you're ready to be part of a forward-thinking organization that's changing the game for mechanics, apply now and embark on a rewarding journey with us.

At our organization, we're on a mission to revolutionize the opportunities available in the mechanic industry by pioneering remote mechanic jobs. We believe that skilled mechanics shouldn't be limited by traditional brick-and-mortar settings but should have the flexibility to work remotely, leveraging technology to provide expert services wherever they're needed. By embracing remote work, we're empowering mechanics to optimize their schedules, reduce commuting time, and expand their reach to serve clients beyond geographical boundaries. Through innovative platforms and robust support systems, we're creating a new paradigm in the mechanic industry, one that prioritizes efficiency, accessibility, and inclusivity. Position Summary

Prometheus Federal Services (PFS) is a trusted partner of federal health agencies. We are seeking a Technical Project Manager to support the Veterans Healthcare Administration (VHA). This role will provide leadership, coordination, and oversight for program activities supporting healthcare scheduling modernization, interoperability, workflow transformation, training, adoption, and operational sustainment across VA and Community Care environments.

The Technical Project Manager will serve as the primary point of coordination across stakeholders, technical teams, operational leaders, and program executives to ensure successful delivery of complex healthcare transformation initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess significant healthcare program management experience, strong leadership skills, and a demonstrated ability to manage enterprise-scale implementations in highly regulated environments.

Essential Functions
Reasonable Accommodations Statement

To succeed in this job, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential duty. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Program Leadership & Strategic Oversight

  • Lead planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout activities for enterprise healthcare transformation initiatives.
  • Provide program leadership and strategic direction across multiple workstreams supporting scheduling modernization, interoperability, workflow optimization, and operational adoption.
  • Establish and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, and execution roadmaps.
  • Manage program governance processes, decision tracking, risk mitigation, issue management, and executive reporting activities.
  • Ensure alignment of program objectives with VA strategic priorities, healthcare modernization initiatives, and Veteran access goals.

Healthcare Scheduling Modernization

  • Support implementation and sustainment activities associated with the Enterprise Patient Scheduling (EPS) platform and related scheduling modernization initiatives.
  • Coordinate efforts across scheduling, referral management, care coordination, provider network integration, and interoperability workstreams.
  • Monitor implementation progress and identify opportunities to improve operational effectiveness, scheduling efficiency, and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with functional and technical teams to streamline business processes and improve scheduling workflows.
  • Ensure delivery activities support the enterprise vision of unified scheduling across direct care, community care, virtual care, and Veteran self-scheduling channels.

Stakeholder Engagement & Executive Communications

  • Serve as the primary liaison among program leadership, VA stakeholders, clinical operations teams, technical teams, and external partners.
  • Prepare executive briefings, dashboards, status reports, issue analyses, and program updates.
  • Facilitate governance meetings, leadership reviews, strategic planning sessions, and working groups.
  • Develop communications that effectively translate complex technical and operational information for diverse stakeholder audiences.
  • Establish collaborative relationships with stakeholders to build consensus and support program objectives.

Change Management, Training & Adoption

  • Lead organizational change management activities supporting enterprise deployment and adoption initiatives.
  • Develop and execute stakeholder engagement, communication, training, and adoption strategies.
  • Coordinate training development and delivery efforts, including user guides, job aids, onboarding materials, and role-based training programs.
  • Monitor adoption, utilization, and performance metrics to assess program effectiveness and support continuous improvement activities.
  • Identify organizational impacts, potential resistance points, and mitigation strategies to increase successful adoption of new processes and technologies.
  • Support site readiness assessments, activation planning, post-deployment support, and lessons learned activities.

Interoperability, Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Support healthcare interoperability initiatives involving scheduling, referral management, provider data exchange, and care coordination capabilities.
  • Oversee business process analysis and workflow improvement efforts to optimize operational outcomes.
  • Coordinate solution engineering and issue resolution activities among technical and operational stakeholders.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement by identifying performance gaps and recommending corrective actions.
  • Support performance measurement, quality management, operational readiness assessments, and program maturity initiatives.

Risk Management & Compliance

  • Identify, assess, and manage program risks, issues, dependencies, and resource constraints.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable federal, VA, privacy, security, and governance requirements.
  • Support audit readiness, documentation management, and quality assurance activities.
  • Maintain accountability for program deliverables, performance outcomes, and contractual commitments.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, Public Health, Business Administration, Information Systems, Program Management, or a related field. Master's Degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 6 years of experience managing healthcare programs, initiatives, or enterprise transformation efforts.
  • Demonstrated experience planning, managing, executing, and closing complex healthcare programs.
  • Experience supporting integrated healthcare delivery systems, healthcare modernization initiatives, or large-scale healthcare technology implementations.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare operations, clinical workflows, and healthcare technology implementations.
  • Experience leading organizational change management and adoption initiatives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level briefing development and presentation experience.
  • Experience with program governance, risk management, performance measurement, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent project/program management certification.
  • Authorized to work in the U.S. indefinitely without sponsorship.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.
Preferred Qualification
  • Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA), or other federal healthcare agencies.
  • Experience supporting scheduling modernization, referral management, community care programs, or healthcare interoperability initiatives.
  • Familiarity with healthcare standards, APIs, interoperability frameworks, and health information exchange concepts.
  • Experience leading enterprise-wide deployments, adoption programs, and operational transformation initiatives across geographically dispersed organizations.
  • Experience working in Agile, hybrid, or large-scale program management environments.
  • Certification in Organizational Change Management (Prosci or equivalent).
  • Experience managing programs involving training development, field activation, and end-user adoption.

raw.excerpt: Wann hast du zuletzt ein Buch lektoriert, das Zwölfjährige freiwillig zu Ende lesen?
raw.description:
Wann hast du zuletzt ein Buch lektoriert, das Zwölfjährige freiwillig zu Ende lesen?

Bei uns ist das der Job. BrainBook macht Bücher mit den bekanntesten YouTubern Deutschlands: Romane, Comic-Romane, Reihen, Schwerpunkt Leser zwischen 8 und 14. Sechs Jahre alt, komplett remote, kein Gremium, kein Warten. Wir wirbeln eine Branche auf, die sich seit dreißig Jahren kaum bewegt hat, und wir haben gerade erst angefangen.

Dafür brauchen wir eine Lektorin, die mehr kann als Kommas: Storyaufbau, Figuren, Tempo, Terminhärte. Die dem Autor sagt, was nicht funktioniert, und ihm zeigt, wie es geht. Die lieber entscheidet als abstimmt.

Wenn du in deinem Verlag diejenige bist, die alle fragen, wenn es brennt: Wir sollten reden.

Aufgaben

  • Du prüfst und bewertest eingehende Manuskripte und Exposés.
  • Du lektorierst eigenverantwortlich Kinder- und Jugendromane sowie Comic-Romane, von Plot und Figurenentwicklung bis zur sauberen Satzvorlage.
  • Du übernimmst das Korrektorat und die Satz- und Umbruchkontrolle bis zur Druckfreigabe. Lektorat und Korrektorat liegen bei uns in einer Hand.
  • Du führst unsere Autor:innen und Ghostwriter: Briefing, Feedbackschleifen, Meilensteine nachhalten.
  • Du bist im Buchinhalt die Ansprechpartnerin für unsere Creator und übersetzt deren Wünsche in eine Geschichte, die funktioniert.
  • Du hältst den Erscheinungstermin, planst rückwärts von der Druckfreigabe und sagst früh Bescheid, wenn es eng wird.
  • Du schreibst Klappentexte, entwickelst Reihenkonzepte mit und machst Themenrecherchen und Marktanalysen.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens zwei bis drei Jahre Erfahrung im Lektorat von Belletristik für Kinder oder Jugendliche, im Verlag, in einer Agentur, bei einem Buchpackager oder freiberuflich. Mehr ist ausdrücklich willkommen.
  • Gefühl für Storyaufbau, Figurenentwicklung, Perspektive und Dialog. Du erkennst, warum ein Kapitel nicht zieht, und kannst es benennen.
  • Du liest Kinder- und Jugendromane auch privat. Wer nur Sachbücher liest, hat für diese Stelle das falsche Ohr.
  • Sicheres Korrektorat, Erfahrung mit Reihen und mit festen Erscheinungsterminen.
  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau.
  • Du arbeitest im Home-Office selbstorganisiert, hältst Zusagen ein und meldest Probleme, bevor sie Termine kosten.
  • Sicher im Word-Änderungsmodus. Teams und ClickUp lernst du bei uns in einer Woche.

Kein Ausschluss: Sachbuch, Schulbuch oder Wissenschaft im Lebenslauf sind in Ordnung, solange du Belletristik für Kinder belegen kannst. Erfahrung mit YouTubern oder Influencern brauchst du nicht, die bringen wir dir bei. Storygefühl bringst du mit.

Benefits

  • Einstieg 34.000 bis 37.000 € Fixgehalt im Jahr, je nach Erfahrung, plus Prämien ohne Deckel. Für jeden pünktlich erschienenen Titel und für jeden SPIEGEL-Bestseller zahlen wir extra, realistisch 3.000 bis 4.000 € im Jahr. Wer liefert, verdient hier mehr, und zwar automatisch, nicht nach Verhandlung.
  • Vollzeit, unbefristet, 100 % Home-Office, Firmensitz in Kiedrich.
  • 40 Stunden mit Arbeitszeitkonto: Plusstunden verfallen nicht, ab 37 Plusstunden zahlen wir automatisch aus.
  • 25 Urlaubstage, 50 € steuerfreier Sachbezug pro Monat, Notebook gestellt.
  • Eine feste Ansprechperson, echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins und kurze Wege bis zur Geschäftsführung.
  • Bücher mit Creatorn, die deine Zielgruppe jeden Tag sieht. Deine Arbeit steht danach im Handel, nicht in der Schublade.
  • Reisekosten zu Messen und Terminen am Firmensitz übernehmen wir.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. We are looking for proactive, results-driven individuals to join our dynamic team.

We are seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented Account Manager to join our growing Customer Success team. In this role, you will manage the day-to-day relationship for a broad portfolio of personal injury law firms, ensuring a positive customer experience from onboarding through ongoing engagement.

The Account Manager serves as a primary point of contact for our legal professional customers, supporting day-to-day needs, conducting regular check-ins, and driving adoption of Zipliens' services through structured, repeatable engagement across a high volume of accounts. By fostering strong relationships and collaborating with internal teams, you will help build long-term partnerships that drive both customer satisfaction and organizational success.

Requirements

Responsibilities:

Customer Management & Engagement

  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for a portfolio of assigned firms, addressing inquiries promptly and escalating issues when necessary.
  • Schedule and conduct regular, value-centric customer check-ins to validate account health and strengthen relationships.
  • Manage CRM workflows and sequences to support ongoing customer engagement and account health at scale.
  • Support customer appreciation initiatives, including office visits and customer gifting programs, to foster positive and lasting relationships.

Data-Driven Insights & Reporting

  • Generate reports and track customer data for assigned accounts.
  • Monitor activity and engagement trends, identifying potential risks or opportunities within the account portfolio.
  • Share qualitative and quantitative observations with your leadership and take follow-up actions to support customer outcomes, escalating accounts that show signs of elevated complexity or risk.

Customer Onboarding & Training

  • Create and maintain accurate customer records during onboarding.
  • Schedule and deliver user training sessions to ensure effective adoption of the Zipliens portal.
  • Orchestrate strategic, milestone and KPI-driven pilot launch plans on key new or expansion accounts

Issue Resolution & Risk Mitigation

  • Identify customer issues and escalate to your leadership when an account's complexity or value exceeds standard scope.

Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Lien Resolution, and Tech teams to ensure seamless onboarding, customer engagement, and overall customer satisfaction.

Event Participation

  • Attend industry events and webinars as needed to represent the company, engage with current customers, and network with potential customers.

Organizational Support

  • Adapt to evolving customer and business needs.
  • Contribute feedback and recommendations to improve processes and the customer experience.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in customer services, customer management, or sales, preferably within the legal tech, SaaS, or personal injury industry.
  • Bachelor's degree required; focus in business, law, or a related field preferred.
  • Proficient in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and Microsoft Office Suite; advanced CRM experience or certification highly desirable, AI experience a plus.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships quickly.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working with customer data and reports to monitor trends and support follow-up actions.
  • Ability to conduct effective virtual user training presentations.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-motivated and goal-oriented; team player with a collaborative mindset.
  • Ability to travel 10-20%.

Benefits

  • Private Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Company HSA contributions for HDHP participants
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (Health & Dependent Care)
  • Company-Paid Short-Term Disability Coverage
  • Voluntary Long-Term Disability, Life, AD&D, and Supplemental Coverage Options
  • 401(k) Plan with Company Match
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick Time & Select Holidays)
  • Paid Maternity & Paternity Leave
  • Remote-First Work Environment (Flexible Work from Home)

Pay Disclosure: The total base salary range for this role is $60,000 to $80,000 annually. Final compensation will be determined based on skills and experience.

Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.

Summary
The Senior Retirement Benefits Analyst serves as the main contact with HRIS in the design, development, and administration of the retirement benefit programs in the HCMS system for the enterprise. The Senior Retirement Benefits Analyst should possess a clear understanding of the HCMS benefits module to assist the retirement benefits team in troubleshooting issues. The Senior Retirement Benefits Analyst will serve as the leader in the retirement area when developing efficient processes in the HCMS system.

Job Duties

  • Serves as a subject matter expert in both the retirement area and the HCMS systems as a point of contract for escalated colleagues retirement benefits program inquiries to resolve through investigation and coordination with internal and external partner. Assist the retirement benefits analysts in researching and troubleshooting retirement plan issues and work with HRIS to resolve the issues. The Senior Retirement Benefits Analyst will work with HRIS to identify the root cause of the issues identified to resolve by updating the HCMS benefits module or HCMS processes.
  • Senior Retirement Benefits Analyst will serve as the liaison between HRIS, IT and the retirement team when researching issues in the retirement benefits. They will work with HRIS in creating processes to create audit reports to improve the efficiency of processing retirement benefits. Senior Retirement Benefits Analyst will educate the retirement team in the standard operating procedures for the HCMS benefits module.

  • Skilled in process management
  • Ability to listen actively, communicate clearly and empathetically, take responsibility, adapt, and exercise self-control under pressure.

raw.description:
Controller, Accounting Operations & FP&A

Join a remote-first, sponsor-backed professional services business at a stage where the finance function is becoming a true growth lever. This is an internal Controller role for someone who is already strong in accounting operations and wants a broader seat across faster close, cleaner reporting, FP&A support, acquisition integration, automation, and direct partnership with senior finance and executive leadership.

The Opportunity

The company is scaling through a mix of core services growth, new offerings, and acquisition activity. The finance team needs a hands-on Controller who can keep the accounting engine accurate and dependable while helping modernize how the business closes, reports, forecasts, and integrates new lines of business.

This is not a narrow bookkeeping seat, and it is not a hands-off VP Finance role. It is ideal for a highly capable Controller who wants to stay close to the GL, own the accounting operating cadence, and build toward broader FP&A and strategic finance exposure over time.

What You Will Own

Accounting Operations

Own day-to-day accounting operations across payroll, accounts receivable, accounts payable, reconciliations, month-end close, and reporting workflows.

Lead the close process with a focus on speed, accuracy, reviewability, and repeatability.

Maintain clean financial records that support leadership reporting, board reporting, audit readiness, and future lender-related data requests.

Oversee and develop one direct report in a senior accountant / accounting specialist capacity.

Support required registrations, compliance-related finance administration, and other operational finance needs as they arise.

Reporting, FP&A, and Leadership Support

Build and improve financial reporting packages so leadership can review results earlier, identify insights faster, and make better decisions.

Support monthly variance analysis, fluctuation analysis, forecasting, budgeting, and longer-term planning exercises.

Help prepare operational finance inputs for board reporting, annual budgeting, sponsor-backed reporting, audit readiness, and valuation-related needs.

Partner with the finance leader on lender-facing data preparation if and when the company moves into lender relationships.

Translate accurate accounting outputs into useful finance insights for a scaling professional services business.

Systems, Automation, and Process Modernization

Assess the current finance and accounting tech stack and help determine what should be automated, upgraded, or replaced over time.

Improve capacity in the controller function through better processes and tools rather than simply adding headcount.

Identify opportunities to automate month-end close, reconciliations, AP workflows, reporting packages, and recurring data pulls.

Support future ERP, accounting system, forecasting tool, or related finance systems implementation work.

Acquisition Integration

Help integrate accounting operations for a recently acquired business line currently relying on informal or part-time bookkeeping support.

Create a more scalable accounting process for the acquired business, including fixed-price services revenue and related reporting.

Support acquisition-related accounting integration work such as GL alignment, reporting consistency, data cleanup, and operating cadence.

Bring practical judgment to a business where acquisition activity and integration work are expected to remain part of the finance environment.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You have strong Controller-level experience owning accounting operations in a smaller or mid-sized business where finance and accounting responsibilities are not overly siloed.

You are comfortable being accountable for the GL, close, reporting accuracy, and accounting process discipline.

You have meaningful exposure to FP&A, forecasting, variance analysis, budgeting, or board reporting, even if your core strength is still accounting.

You have worked in a sponsor-backed, PE-backed, VC-backed, or similarly high-accountability environment where speed, reporting quality, and leadership visibility matter.

You have experience with professional services, project-based accounting, fixed-price services revenue, or other operationally complex revenue models.

You can support a business with a mix of services and subscription-style revenue, even if project-based accounting has been the more complex part of your background.

You have either participated in acquisition integration work before or have strong adjacent experience organizing new entities, business lines, systems, and reporting flows.

You are comfortable working directly with senior finance leadership and being a reliable leverage point for better reporting, analysis, and operating cadence.

You are hands-on, fast, precise, and willing to improve the process while still doing the underlying accounting work well.

Nice-to-Haves

ERP implementation, accounting system implementation, forecasting tool implementation, or finance systems modernization experience.

Automation experience across close, reconciliations, AP, reporting, or recurring finance workflows.

Experience preparing data for lenders, debt reporting, covenant tracking, or quarterly lender packages.

Familiarity with government contracting, federal contractor environments, regulated services businesses, or compliance-heavy operating models.

Experience in a multi-service-line business with project-based, fixed-price, managed services, and subscription-style revenue.

Audit support experience in a sponsor-backed or acquisition-oriented environment.

The First 90 Days

First 30 Days

Learn the current accounting operations, reporting cadence, systems, team structure, and business model.

Identify the biggest opportunities to streamline month-end close and reporting package preparation.

Begin improving reporting workflows so leadership can review results earlier and with more confidence.

First 60 Days

Take meaningful ownership of integrating accounting operations for the recently acquired business line.

Move acquired-business accounting away from informal or part-time support toward a scalable internal process.

Continue tightening the monthly close and recurring reporting cadence.

First 90 Days

Establish a clearer operating rhythm across close, reporting, finance inputs, and leadership review.

Help prepare for upcoming budgeting, audit, valuation, and sponsor-backed reporting needs.

Build a practical roadmap for finance tech stack improvements and automation opportunities.

Who This Role Is Best For

This role is a strong fit if you are already a highly capable Controller and want your next role to stretch beyond traditional accounting operations. You may be earlier in your career than a VP Finance, but you have the judgment, technical accounting foundation, and operating pace to become a broader finance leader over time.

You will likely enjoy this role if you are energized by a scaling sponsor-backed company, direct exposure to finance leadership, building structure without a fully built playbook, and making accounting faster, cleaner, and more useful to the business.

Location & Work Model

Remote role.

This is an internal corporate finance role, not a client-facing consulting delivery role.

Compensation

Base salary range: $140,000-$175,000.

Evaluation Process

We use AI-enabled tools to help compare candidates consistently and objectively against role-related qualifications, and these evaluations do not consider protected characteristics such as gender, race, age, religion, disability status, national origin, veteran status, or any other non-job-related personal attribute.

Apply

If you are a hands-on Controller who can run accounting operations, improve reporting, support acquisition integration, and grow into broader FP&A exposure, this is a high-impact opportunity inside a scaling sponsor-backed business.

Apply now and get a response within 24 hours.

Salary: $140,000 – $175,000 / year

Who We Are

Verily Health is a data platform and technology company purpose-built to power AI-enabled precision health solutions that accelerate research and improve care for individuals and communities. Uniquely positioned at the intersection of technology, data science, and healthcare, Verily transforms multimodal health data into insights, models, and actions that make healthcare more personalized, predictive, and precise.

Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Clinical Pharmacy Informaticist with expertise in HL7 FHIR. The ideal candidate will have in-depth knowledge of healthcare data standards, and industry standards, with a focus on Integrating, enriching, and harmonizing clinical data. This role will participate in ensuring the accuracy and usability of data across our organization, ultimately supporting various patient care and research efforts.

Responsibilities

  • Architect FHIR-compliant data models, ensuring all instantiated resources align with specific implementation guides (IGs), profiles, and internal architectural standards.

  • Design and operationalize sophisticated data harmonization and enrichment strategies to unify disparate data streams from EHRs, HIEs, and claims sources.

  • Act as the subject matter expert for clinical ontologies (SNOMED CT, LOINC, ICD-10, RxNorm); define and maintain custom value sets to support specialized clinical use cases.

  • Establish rigorous validation frameworks and automated rules to ensure the clinical accuracy, consistency, and longitudinal integrity of our data assets.

  • Develop clear and concise documentation that effectively communicates data design requirements to engineering teams and stakeholders with varying levels of technical expertise.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a closely related technical degree.

  • Professional Certificate or Master’s Degree in Clinical Informatics or equivalent professional experience in a clinical informatics role.

  • Minimum of 5 years experience working in clinical informatics or data integration in Healthcare or Life Sciences industries

  • Demonstrated proficiency in navigating the complexities of interoperability standards and frameworks (HL7 v2, FHIR CDA/CCD-A, NCPDP) and data models (FHIR R4/R5, OMOP).

  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL.

​

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with dbt (data build tool), Jupyter Notebooks, and Experience in healthcare data integration.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

About the team

You'll be part of Zillow's Product Management organization, where cross-functional teams come together to build customer-centered experiences that make it easier to unlock life's next chapter. The Connections Platform team specializes in the technology that drives seamless connections between all Zillow lines of business and our valued customers — dependably enabling meaningful connections no matter where they are in their journey. We value curiosity, thoughtful collaboration, and a shared commitment to creating impactful products for customers, partners, and the business.

About the role

The Senior Product Manager, Connections Platform leads complex product strategy and roadmap execution for a platform that serves as the foundation for multiple products across Zillow. This role partners closely with engineering, design, data, and business stakeholders to define vision, prioritize work, and deliver scalable, data-informed solutions — including our core Leads service and Switchboard Agents, an agentic harnessing platform aimed at enabling agentic experiences across Zillow.

You Will Get To

  • Define and evolve product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Connections Platform, aligning with company strategic priorities and customer needs

  • Lead end-to-end product lifecycle — from discovery and requirements through launch, iteration, and optimization — using quantitative and qualitative insights to guide decisions

  • Partner with teams across Zillow to understand their needs and translate them into clear product requirements and technical trade-offs

  • Build prototypes, auditing and configuration portals, and more by leveraging AI tools such as Replit, Cursor, and Claude Code

  • Analyze leads data and leverage AI tools to identify opportunities to improve our platforms and ultimately improve the customer experience

  • Shape the future of agentic connections by building services that enable the next generation of lead nurturing, classification, and customer engagement

  • Mentor less experienced product managers or peers on product discovery, prioritization, and execution best practices

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $148,600.00 - $237,400.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $141,200.00 - $225,600.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including experience in a platform-focused role

  • Demonstrated experience defining product vision and strategy, managing roadmaps, and guiding features from discovery through launch in cross-functional environments

  • Ability to understand and define API contracts, database schemas, and best-in-class pipeline architectures

  • Proven ability to use data, AI tools, and experimentation to inform product decisions and drive measurable impact

  • Experience building scalable products that anticipate future needs and serve a wide range of internal clients and use cases

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills to navigate and align diverse requirements across multiple teams

  • Or an equivalent combination of education and experience

  • Nice to have: experience with agentic platforms, data modeling, or lead management systems

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.


Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.


Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

raw.description:
Company Overview

Shriners Children’s is an organization that respects, supports, and values each other. Named as the 2025 best mid-sized employer by Forbes, we are engaged in providing excellence in patient care, embracing multi-disciplinary education, and research with global impact. We foster a learning environment that values evidenced based practice, experience, innovation, and critical thinking. Our compassion, integrity, accountability, and resilience define us as leaders in pediatric specialty care for our children and their families.

With 20+ hospitals, outpatient clinics, ambulatory care centers and outreach locations across the globe, we provide excellent care to children up to age 18 regardless of their family’s ability to pay or insurance status. Please click here to learn more about our locations.

Job Description

The Epic Scheduling Template Analyst is responsible for the creation of, and updates to, provider templates for assigned areas incorporating the Guidelines for Template Standardization. Monitors master and daily schedule change requests. Works with Providers, Clinic/Practice Managers, Supervisors and/or Secretaries, and Schedulers to identify the most efficient, streamlined appointment scheduling process by incorporating various scheduling options into the provider schedule definition. Assists with the training of Template Builders to ensure consistency and adherence to all approved scheduling standards. Develops and modifies scheduling templates to optimize provider time in clinics; assists in improving patient access, provider book rates, and provider productivity.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provides oversight of master schedule templates for new and existing providers including new appointment type requests (i.e. new patient; established patient; urgent; etc.) and visit type load balance.

  • Works in conjunction with Ambulatory Operations to identify, review, and make recommendations to Providers and Practice Managers of suggested master template enhancements.

  • Ensures change requests are completed according to process guidelines including changes to existing appointment types, working off worklist and proper worklist assignment of bumped patients.

  • Maintains detailed documentation to support change requests within ServiceNow.

  • Communicates status of change requests with Providers, Senior Directors, Clinic/Practice Managers, Group Administrators, Supervisors and/or Secretaries, and Schedulers via Service Now.

  • Identifies need for scheduling changes based on review of scheduling set-up and change requests, as well as scheduling scenarios and trends.

  • Works with EPIC Cadence Team and other I.S. resources to optimize functionality of systems.

  • Recommends improved processes and changes to scheduling definition to provide the most efficient method of scheduling for schedulers and group secretaries.

  • Recommends improved processes, including enhanced system functionality, that address specific clinical, operational and business critical success factors.

  • Monitors schedules to assure templates are being utilized as designed.

  • Provides technical and administrative support to the scheduling areas.

  • Prepares and delivers presentations related to master schedules as requested by Ambulatory Operations

  • Works closely with the clinic practices and Practice Managers on scheduling and capacity related projects.

  • Suggests the use of new products and techniques as they are made available.

  • Identifies potential training needs and works with clinic practices and Practice Managers to provide appropriate training.

  • Performs additional tasks, which may be assigned, to maintain or improve the conduct of business.

  • Standard Staffing Level Responsibilities

  • Complies with established departmental policies, procedures and objectives.

  • Attends variety of meetings, conferences, seminars as required or directed.

  • Demonstrates use of Quality Improvement in daily operations.

  • Complies with all health and safety regulations and requirements.

  • Respects diverse views and approaches, demonstrates Standards of Respect, and contributes to creating and maintaining an environment of professionalism, tolerance, civility and acceptance toward all employees, patients and visitors.

  • Maintains, regular, reliable, and predictable attendance.

  • Performs other similar and related duties as required or directed.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3 years of scheduling experience

  • 1 year of master template experience

  • Proficiency in medical terminology.

  • EPIC Cadence system.

  • MS Office

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master template experience in healthcare environment

Compensation is determined based on years of relevant experience and departmental equity.

Annotation is what helps AI make sense of the world. As an annotator, you may be invited to take part in online projects such as rating AI-generated content, evaluating factual accuracy, or comparing responses — when projects are available.

This opportunity is a good fit for candidates open to part-time, non-permanent projects. Ideally, contributors will have:

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project (when available) → Complete tasks → Get paid

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $19/hr. raw.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you’ll be responsible for:

The VP, Policy and Regulatory Strategy, Latin America will lead Circle’s public policy, regulatory strategy, and market positioning across the Latin America (LatAm) region. This role will serve as an integral component of the strategy, global policy, and corporate communications leadership team. Working closely with Commercial, Legal, Compliance, Product, Finance and other teams to unlock growth, reduce regulatory friction, and align evolving standards, requiring in-depth understanding and engagement with key regulators and other stakeholders in target markets. The VP will help drive analysis, engagement and regulatory filings culminating in successful company licensure, and operations in certain target markets. The VP will also lead regulatory, policy and other engagements supporting a global market and regulatory environment conducive to the company’s products, solutions, and services.

The VP will also track in an evidence-based manner the global policy, regulatory and market acceptance of digital currencies, blockchain-based payments systems and crypto-assets more generally. This will be a dynamic role that will help inform company-wide market expansion efforts, regulatory engagements and competitive positioning.

What you'll work on:

  • Formulation of regulatory engagement, stakeholder mapping and market segmentation based on overall company market expansion plans.

  • Reviewing present and future regulatory requirements in target markets, alongside legal, compliance and operational leaders.

  • Market expansion and regulatory efforts around the world, prioritized by markets and partners.

  • Creation of regulatory consultation responses, including requests for information, comment and other engagements with external stakeholders.

  • Building coalitions with stakeholders to advance the regulatory agenda in support of the development of the internet financial system.

  • Collaborating with business and other cross-functional leaders to enable business success.

  • Leading a dynamic global strategy, policy and communications team helping drive a conducive market environment for the company’s products, solutions and services.

What you’ll bring to Circle:

Core Requirements:

  • 14+ years of legal, policy, regulatory and policymaking experience at the nexus of emerging technology, financial services and global markets.

  • 8+ years of experience managing and leading teams.

  • Technical virtuosity, policy instincts and relationships at the highest levels of government, policymaking and regulatory matters shaping the future of money and payments.

  • Proven knowledge at the strategic and technical levels in regulatory engagement in the payments and financial service domains.

  • In depth knowledge of LatAm policy, regulatory, legal and licensing requirements for the payments, digital currencies, crypto-assets and blockchain-based market.

  • Familiarity with generative AI models (ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.) and prompt development.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience building cross-functional teams across geographic locations and delivering results.

  • Experience/familiarity with Slack, Apple MacOS and GSuite.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.

raw.description:
Business Area:

Corp. Strategy

Seniority Level:

Director

Job Description:

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

Cloudera’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) function sits within the Applied AI organization, and is a specialized AI/ML engineering team focused on accelerating AI adoption within our most strategic enterprise customers. We embed directly with customers to rapidly pilot AI use cases, solve real-world business challenges, and help operationalize advanced AI capabilities within enterprise environments.

Cloudera FDEs operate at the intersection of customer engineering, AI innovation, and enterprise deployment - driving high-impact AI outcomes for customers and codifying solution patterns for repeatable delivery at scale.

About the role

Cloudera is looking for a seasoned full-stack ML engineer who can embed with customers to design technical use cases, and ship scalable enterprise AI/ML solutions on Cloudera. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you will:

  • Build & Prototype AI Apps - Develop full-stack AI/ML applications on Cloudera to demonstrate how AI and agentic systems solve real enterprise use cases

  • Partner with Strategic Customers - Work directly with customer teams to drive AI and agentic use cases from early prototype toward production readiness

  • Shape Enterprise AI Architecture - Advise customer leaders on AI roadmaps, solution design, deployment, and AI use cases

  • Codify Solution Patterns - Standardize successful patterns into repeatable reference architectures, productized solutions, starter kits, and internal playbooks

  • Multiply impact - Be a thought leader, mentor Cloudera teams, and contribute to resources that grow our AI capability. Channel field and customer signal back to Product teams to improve our AI platform and products

We are excited if you have:

  • 7+ years of experience building and deploying production-grade systems, including 2-4 years experience building ML systems or GenAI/agentic applications

  • Strong hands-on software engineering, data engineering, and applied AI/ML skills, with experience building full-stack ML applications or agentic systems using modern AI frameworks and tooling

  • Experience with foundation models, context engineering, fine-tuning, semantic search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic workflows

  • Deep understanding of LLMOps/MLOps practices including evaluation, observability, serving, monitoring, and lifecycle management

  • Experience designing and implementing scalable AI solution architectures aligned to enterprise standards (security, governance, compliance, etc.)

  • The ability to engage directly with customers, both technical and executive audiences - to translate needs into actionable technical strategy

  • High agency with the ability to operate autonomously and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving customer environments

  • A collaborative mindset and passion for enabling others through mentorship, internal enablement, or reusable tooling

  • Bsc/Msc/PhD in related field or equivalent experience

  • This is a customer-facing role combining remote and in-person engagement. Occasional travel may be required for on-site customer engagement, industry events, and team meetings - up to 20% depending on business needs.

You may also have:

  • Experience with cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Experience using the Cloudera platform

  • Experience with open source big data technologies like Spark, Iceberg, NiFi, etc

  • Experience with AI infrastructure and runtime technologies including NVIDIA GPUs, inference optimization, model serving, or distributed AI workloads

This role is not eligible for immigration support or relocation.

What you can expect from us:

  • Generous PTO Policy

  • Support work life balance with Unplugged Days

  • Flexible WFH Policy

  • Mental & Physical Wellness programs

raw.description:
Funnel Leasing Inc., is hiring for a Event and Conference Manager that can 'work from anywhere' in the U.S. The Event and Conference Manager owns Funnel’s events and conferences calendar end to end: ideation, logistics, vendor negotiation, branding, and on-site execution. This role also owns the commercial engine behind every event: partnering with SDRs and sales on targeted outreach before events, working with demand gen to make sure every lead gets the right follow-up after, and supporting ABM campaigns that turn event presence into pipeline.

Industry events in-market events and Funnel’s user conference, The Forum, drive significant portion of annual pipeline. This is a revenue-critical role, not just a logistics one. The salary range for this role is $80,000 - $95,000 per year.

Major projects this person will own and be accountable for:

  • 4 annual industry conferences with tradeshow/booth and VIP party presence
  • 1 annual user conference (The Forum)
  • 1 annual employee conference (Funnel Fest)
  • Support for up to a dozen local apartment associations, working with account reps
  • 6 in-office events (board meetings, leadership offsites, VIP meetings)
  • Regional Lunch & Learn events
  • Regional VIP events
  • LinkedIn Live events and webinars

Why Funnel?

We are a 'work from anywhere' in the U.S. SaaS company that centers our services on the renter experience. We develop amazing software that has revolutionized the #proptech industry. And did we mention we have an amazing team that is on #FunnelFire!? Oh, did we forget to tell you we have unlimited PTO, benefits that begin on your first day of employment, P.I.N.K. core values that ROCK, and our team puts the FUN in Funnel!

Who is Funnel Leasing?

Have you ever rented an apartment and wished the process could be better? At Funnel we do too. We know we need to make the process of renting an apartment as easy as purchasing socks on Amazon. We’ve created cloud-based marketing and leasing software that delivers the ultimate rental experience for everyone involved in the process. We’re in the process of transforming the real estate industry through cutting-edge technology built, sold, and supported by the most passionate people you’ll meet.

The Event and Conference Manager essential roles and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

Roles and responsibilities

Event Strategy & Execution

  • Conceptualize differentiated booth designs and VIP experiences with external vendors
  • Build and maintain the events calendar with the marketing team
  • Work with graphic design to finalize promotional assets, swag and VIP gifts
  • Own all event logistics: venue, A/V, catering, shipping, and vendor negotiation for the best rates and terms
  • Set up and maintain event management platforms and related tools (registration, check-in, lead capture) and keep them current across every event
  • Manage registration sites and event landing pages
  • Work with HR to plan and run Funnel Fest, the annual employee conference
  • Travel to and serve as on-site point of contact for all industry conferences, The Forum, and Funnel Fest; staff local or regional events as needed
  • Travel: 20%

Pipeline & Sales Partnership

  • Own outreach planning with SDRs and sales for every event: target account lists, invite cadence, and follow-up ownership before attendees ever arrive
  • Partner with demand gen on post-event follow-up so every lead gets the right next step, fast
  • Support ABM campaigns tied to (and independent of) events: account selection, personalized outreach, and executive experiences for top targets
  • Work with sales to confirm the right people are being invited and shown up for, not just headcount
  • Share attendee lists, overview decks, and other pertinent event information with internal stakeholders
  • Track and report event and campaign ROI: pipeline sourced and influenced, cost per lead, follow-up conversion, to continuously improve strategy
  • Stay current on industry trends, market dynamics, and buyer behavior to keep event strategy sharp
  • Develop relationships with other partners in our space to encourage collaborative events

Team & Office

  • Recruit, train, and manage on-site event staff and any contracted support
  • Lead the Funnel event team on-site to build attendee relationships that support sales objectives
  • (For local Tampa candidates) Keep the Odessa, FL office presentable and stocked; staff it up to 2 days/week to coordinate deliveries and prep for on-site meetings

Budget & Vendor Management

  • Develop and manage event budgets and marketing plans against approved objectives
  • Evaluate new event opportunities before committing budget or staff time
  • Administer all phases of the event function: planning, marketing, servicing, and admin, within approved budget

Culture

  • Creative. You think of outside-the-box ideas that have a lasting impact on prospects and event attendees.
  • Style. You’re often told you have great taste and stay on top of trends and culture.
  • Hyper-organized. You manage (and can cite) highly interdependent, complex projects and keep every workstream on track without losing details along the way.
  • Sales-minded. You obsess over the persona each event is meant to reach, and make sure sales, SDRs, and demand gen are amplifying your efforts toward the right attendees.
  • A team player. You collaborate daily with Marketing, Sales, SDRs, Demand Gen, Product, and other teams, and can work across a range of disciplines to get things done.
  • Trendsetter. You push the status quo and look for a better way to improve Funnel’s buyer journey. You keep up to date with others pushing boundaries.
  • Performs other duties as assigned and modified at the manager’s discretion.

Education, Work Experience, and Certifications

  • Hotel/hospitality degree a plus, not required
  • 6+ years of progressive event or field marketing management experience; B2B SaaS or similar preferred
  • Hands-on experience setting up and administering event management platforms (e.g. Whova, Cvent, Splash, Bizzabo, or similar) and other registration/lead capture tools
  • Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, or similar) for outreach and follow-up tracking
  • Exposure to ABM strategy and execution a plus
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and a track record working cross-functionally, especially with sales and SDR teams
  • Excellent presentation skills, both virtual and in-person
  • Proven track record of running events that produce pipeline, not just attendance
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Local candidates to Odessa/Tampa, FL a plus

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Funnel, we are committed to building a proptech company that is as diverse as the multifamily industry we serve, and that means to not only live our inclusivity, but also to support and encourage it among all of society. If you are excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Funnel provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals without regard to race, creed, color, citizenship, religion, national origin, age, sex, familial or marital status, pregnancy, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability, or any other legally-protected status in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws, regulations, and ordinances.

Employees must be able to perform all essential job functions, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Job Responsibilities

The above statements reflect the general duties, responsibilities and competencies considered necessary to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the job and should not be considered as a detailed description of all the work requirements of the position. Funnel may change the specific job duties with or without prior notice based on the needs of the organization.

Benefits

Employees may be eligible for various benefits. Generally, we provide employee access to:

  • Health insurance
  • Dental and Vision insurance
  • Company paid Life/AD&D
  • Long-term Disability insurance
  • Short-term Disability insurance
  • Term Life insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Retirement Plan - 2% company match
  • EAP

In addition to these benefits, we also offer

  • Remote/Hybrid Opportunities
  • Uncapped Discretionary Time off
  • Sick Leave
  • 14 paid holidays
  • One time remote work stipend
  • Employee recognition program
  • Employee-led Groups (ELG’s)

Responsibilities:

  • • Works with project managers, business analysts, data stewards, architects, and product owners to understand how business requirements and technical specifications will translate to actual work product across Customer MDM, Informatica Product 360 (P360), and enterprise data platforms.
  • • Maintains a culture of open communication, collaboration, mutual respect and productive behaviors; hires, trains and retains top tier talent and mentors team members to new and fulfilling career experiences.
  • • Experience with Customer MDM platforms such as Informatica MDM, Informatica Product 360 (P360), Reltio, Semarchy, Profisee, SAP MDG, or comparable technologies.

  • • Designs, develops, configures, and supports Customer MDM and Informatica Product 360 (P360) solutions to ensure accurate, consistent, and trusted customer and product master data across enterprise systems.
  • • Develops and maintains product data models, taxonomies, classifications, attributes, reference data, and hierarchy structures within Informatica Product 360.
  • • Partners with business stakeholders, product data stewards, merchandising teams, and domain experts to define and implement product data governance, workflow processes, business rules, and validation rules within Informatica P360.
  • • Develops integrations between MDM platforms, Informatica Product 360, CRM systems, ERP systems, supplier platforms, digital applications, eCommerce platforms, and downstream consuming applications.
  • • Supports customer identity management, data matching, survivorship rules, hierarchy management, deduplication processes, product enrichment, and enterprise data governance initiatives.
  • • Configures and supports Informatica Product 360 workflows, approval processes, data enrichment activities, publishing processes, and business validations to ensure completeness and quality of product information.
  • • Supports product onboarding, catalog management, digital asset management, data enrichment, classification management, and syndication capabilities within Informatica Product 360.
  • • Understands lifecycle of various technology sub-systems that comprise the Master Data Management and Product Information Management ecosystem (i.e., version, release, roadmap), including current capabilities, compatibilities, limitations and dependencies; understands and advises of optimal upgrade paths.
  • • Leverages relationships with key IT, QA, Data Governance, Product Management, and other corporate colleagues by communicating and collaborating on cross-functional initiatives.
  • • Works with project managers, business analysts, data stewards, and product owners to understand how business requirements and technical specifications will translate to actual work product across enterprise data platforms.
  • • Develops technical documentation, such as system context diagrams, design documents, data flow diagrams, interface specifications, workflow configurations, and release procedures.
  • • Participates in troubleshooting efforts for production issues of all levels and severities through a hands-on approach, including root cause analysis, defect resolution, incident management, and coordination with third-party vendors as appropriate.
  • • Provides ongoing production support for Customer MDM, Informatica Product 360 applications, integrations, data pipelines, and associated systems to ensure system stability and business continuity.

  • • Participates in architecture and design discussions to ensure scalable, maintainable, and secure MDM and Product Information Management solutions aligned with enterprise standards.
  • • Supports release management, application upgrades, environment strategy, platform enhancements, and deployment activities for Informatica Product 360 and Customer MDM platforms.
  • • Works with Data Governance teams to establish and enforce data standards, stewardship processes, business rules, naming conventions, and master data management best practices.
  • • Ensures adherence to data governance standards, security policies, data privacy regulations, and master data management best practices.

Qualifications:

  • • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Management, Information Systems, or related field required.
  • • 3 years required, 5 years preferred experience in a development role in an enterprise environment with responsibility for the delivery, support, and maintenance of enterprise data management solutions.
  • • 3 years required, 5 years preferred experience with Customer Master Data Management (MDM), Product Information Management (PIM), Informatica Product 360 (P360), or related technologies.
  • • 3 years required, 5 years preferred experience developing solutions using modern development tools, integration technologies, and best practices.
  • • Experience supporting production environments and resolving application, integration, workflow, and data-related incidents.
  • • Experience developing and supporting customer and product master data integration and synchronization processes between enterprise applications.
  • • Hands-on experience configuring and supporting Informatica Product 360 data models, hierarchies, taxonomies, classifications, workflows, business validations, and approval processes.
  • • Experience supporting product master data governance, stewardship, enrichment, publication, and syndication processes utilizing Informatica Product 360.
  • • Experience developing integrations between Informatica Product 360 and enterprise systems including SAP, Oracle, ERP, CRM, eCommerce, supplier management, and digital commerce platforms.
  • • Working knowledge of Customer MDM concepts including matching, merging, survivorship, hierarchy management, data stewardship, and data governance.

  • • Working knowledge of relational databases, SQL, data modeling, and data quality management practices.
  • • Experience with production monitoring, incident management, root cause analysis, application support, and operational support processes.
  • • Experience with Informatica technologies including Product 360 (P360), Informatica MDM, Informatica Data Quality (IDQ), PowerCenter, IICS, or related Informatica solutions preferred.

One brand’s welcome flow is driving strong revenue, but the abandoned cart flow is slipping. Another client has a launch coming up and needs a campaign plan that feels premium, sharp, and built to convert.

Later, you lead a client call. You walk them through what is working, what needs to change, and how the next email, SMS, or flow test will drive more sales.

raw.description:
Who we are

At CloudFactory, we are a mission-driven team passionate about unlocking the disruptive potential of AI for the world. By combining advanced technology with a global network of talented experts, we make unusable data usable and inference reliable and trustworthy, driving real-world business value at scale.

More than just a workplace, we're a global community founded on strong relationships and the belief that meaningful work transforms lives. Our commitment to earning, learning, and serving fuels everything we do, as we strive to connect one million people to meaningful work and build leaders worth following.

Our culture

At CloudFactory, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels empowered, valued, and inspired to bring their authentic selves to work. We are:

  • Mission-driven: we focus on creating economic and social impact.
  • People-centric: we care deeply about our team's growth, well-being, and sense of belonging.
  • Innovative: we embrace change and find better ways to do things, together.
  • Globally connected: we foster collaboration between diverse cultures and perspectives.

Location: United States
Project type: One-time paid project
Time commitment: Approximately 1–2 hours
Compensation: $75 for completing the project activity

About the opportunity

CloudFactory is looking for participants to support a short-term transaction validation project that we are administering on behalf of a global payments processing company.

The project is designed to help evaluate the accuracy of how payment transactions are matched to individuals.

As a participant, you'll review a set of recent payment transactions and indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself.

How it works

If selected for the project:

  1. You'll provide the email address(es) you use with selected merchants, subscriptions, apps, or online accounts.
  2. Our payments processing client will use those email address(es) to identify payment transactions it believes are associated with you and securely provide a list of those transactions for the project.
  3. You'll be presented with approximately 50 recent transactions from the last 3 months through the designated project platform. The information shown may include details such as the merchant name, date, amount, payment method, card identifier, and card issuer to help you recognize each transaction.
  4. You'll indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself and, where helpful, add a short note.

The activity is expected to take approximately 1–2 hours.

You will not be asked to provide or upload your own transaction history, bank statements, full card number, online banking login credentials, banking password, PIN, or CVV.

Please note that this is a data validation activity only.

Requirements

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Currently reside in United States.
  • Be an active debit and/or credit card user.
  • Have made purchases or payments within the last three months across a variety of merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be able to recognize your own recent purchases and transactions.
  • Have access to the email address(es) you use with the merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be comfortable providing those email address(es) if selected for the project.
  • Be willing to review approximately 50 transactions and confirm whether or not you recognize them as your own.

Privacy and consent

Because this project involves personal and financial transaction information, privacy and informed consent are essential.

Before participating, you'll receive our Participant Consent & Confidentiality Terms, which explain how your personal information and transaction data will be used and processed as part of the project.

If you qualify and provide your consent, relevant payment transactions will be securely provided to CloudFactory by the end-customer and made available to you through the designated project platform for validation.

You may withdraw your consent and participation in accordance with the terms provided to you before the project begins.

Interested? Complete our short eligibility questionnaire to be considered for this paid project.
